In his arrogance the wicked hotly pursues the afflicted. Let them be caught in the schemes they have devised.
For the wicked boasts of what he desires, and the greedy one curses and despises the LORD.
The wicked, in his pride, does not seek him. All his thoughts are, "There is no God."
His ways prosper at all times. Your judgments are high above him, out of his sight; he sneers at all his adversaries.
He says in his heart, "I will not be shaken. Through all generations I will never meet trouble."
His mouth is full of curses, deceit and oppression; under his tongue are trouble and wickedness.
He sits in ambush in the villages; in hiding places he murders the innocent. His eyes secretly watch for the helpless.
He lies in wait in secret like a lion in its thicket; he lies in wait to seize the afflicted. He seizes the afflicted and drags him off in his net.
He crouches, he bows down, and a crowd of the wretched fall by his might.
He says in his heart, "God has forgotten; he has hidden his face; he will never see."
Rise up, LORD! God, lift up your hand. Do not forget the humble.
Why does the wicked despise God? He says in his heart, "You will not call me to account."
But you do see! For you take note of trouble and grief, to take the matter into your hand. The helpless commit themselves to you; you have been the helper of the fatherless.
Break the arm of the wicked and the evil one; call his wickedness to account until you find no more.
The LORD is King forever and ever; the nations have perished from his land.
You have heard the desire of the humble, LORD; you strengthen their heart; you listen closely,
to do justice for the fatherless and the oppressed, so that mortals who are of the earth may strike terror no more.
For the director. Of David. In the LORD I take refuge. How can you say to me, "Flee like a bird to your mountain"?
For look, the wicked bend the bow; they have fitted their arrow to the string, to shoot from the darkness at the upright in heart.
When the foundations are torn down, what can the righteous do?
The LORD is in his holy temple; the LORD's throne is in heaven. His eyes watch; his gaze tests human beings.
The LORD tests the righteous, but the wicked and those who love violence he hates with all his being.
He will rain snares on the wicked; fire and sulfur and a scorching wind will be the portion of their cup.
For the LORD is righteous; he loves righteous deeds. The upright will see his face.
For the director. According to the Sheminith. A psalm of David.
Save, LORD, for the faithful are no more; the loyal have vanished from among human beings.
They speak lies to one another; with flattering lips and a double heart they speak.
May the LORD cut off all flattering lips, the tongue that speaks boastfully,
those who say, "With our tongue we will prevail; our lips are our own. Who is master over us?"
"Because the afflicted are plundered, because the needy groan, now I will arise," says the LORD. "I will place them in the safety they long for."
The words of the LORD are pure words, like silver refined in a furnace in the ground, purified seven times.
You, LORD, will keep them; you will guard each one from this generation forever.
The wicked prowl on every side, when what is vile is honored among human beings.
For the director. A psalm of David.
How long, LORD? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
How long must I wrestle with my thoughts, with sorrow in my heart every day? How long will my enemy be exalted over me?
Look on me and answer me, LORD my God. Give light to my eyes, or I will sleep the sleep of death,
or my enemy will say, "I have overcome him," and my adversaries will rejoice when I am shaken.
But I trust in your faithful love; my heart will rejoice in your salvation. I will sing to the LORD, for he has been good to me.
For the director. Of David. The fool says in his heart, "There is no God." They are corrupt; they do detestable deeds; there is no one who does good.
The LORD looks down from heaven on human beings, to see if there is anyone who understands, anyone who seeks God.
They have all turned aside; together they have become corrupt. There is no one who does good, not even one.
Do they know nothing, all the evildoers, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and do not call on the LORD?
There they are, in great terror, for God is with the generation of the righteous.
You would frustrate the plans of the afflicted, but the LORD is their refuge.
Oh, that salvation for Israel would come from Zion! When the LORD restores the fortunes of his people, let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad.
A psalm of David. LORD, who may stay as a guest in your tent? Who may live on your holy mountain?
The one who lives blamelessly and does what is right, and speaks the truth from his heart;
who does not go around slandering, does no harm to his neighbor, and does not heap insults on those close to him;
in whose eyes a worthless person is despised, but who honors those who fear the LORD; who keeps his oath even when it hurts, and does not change it;
who does not lend his money at interest, and does not take a bribe against the innocent. Whoever does these things will never be shaken.
A miktam of David. Keep me safe, God, for in you I take refuge.
I said to the LORD, "You are my Lord; I have nothing good apart from you."
As for the holy ones who are in the land, they are the noble ones in whom is all my delight.
The sorrows of those who hurry after another god will multiply. I will not pour out their drink offerings of blood, or take their names on my lips.
LORD, you are my allotted portion and my cup; you hold my lot.
The boundary lines have fallen for me in pleasant places; yes, I have a beautiful inheritance.
I will bless the LORD, who counsels me; even at night my heart instructs me.
I have set the LORD always before me; because he is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
So my heart is glad and my whole being rejoices; my body too will rest secure.
For you will not abandon my life to Sheol; you will not let your faithful one see the pit.
You make known to me the path of life. In your presence there is fullness of joy; at your right hand there are pleasures forever.
A prayer of David. Hear, LORD, a just cause; listen to my cry; give ear to my prayer, which comes from lips free of deceit.
Let my vindication come from your presence; let your eyes see what is right.
You have tested my heart; you have examined me by night; you have refined me and found nothing. I have resolved that my mouth will not do wrong.
As for the deeds of human beings, by the word of your lips I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.
My steps have held to your paths; my feet have not slipped.
I call on you, for you will answer me, God. Turn your ear to me; hear my words.
Show the wonder of your faithful love, you who save those who take refuge in you from those who rise against them, by your right hand.
Keep me as the pupil of your eye; hide me in the shadow of your wings
from the wicked who assault me, my deadly enemies who surround me.
They have closed up their hearts; with their mouths they speak arrogantly.
They have tracked us down; now they surround us. They set their eyes to throw us to the ground.
He is like a lion eager to tear its prey, like a young lion lurking in hiding.
Rise up, LORD! Confront him; bring him down. Rescue my life from the wicked with your sword,

from men, by your hand, LORD, from men of this world, whose portion is in this life. You fill their belly with what you have stored up; their children have plenty, and they leave what is left to their little ones.
As for me, in righteousness I will see your face; when I awake, I will be satisfied with your likeness.
For the director. Of the servant of the LORD, of David, who spoke to the LORD the words of this song on the day when the LORD rescued him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul.
He said: "I love you, LORD, my strength.
The LORD is my rock, my fortress and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
I call on the LORD, who is worthy of praise, and I am saved from my enemies.
The cords of death surrounded me; the torrents of destruction terrified me.
The cords of Sheol coiled around me; the snares of death confronted me.
In my distress I called on the LORD; to my God I cried for help. From his temple he heard my voice, and my cry for help before him reached his ears.
Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations of the mountains quaked; they shook because he was angry.
Smoke went up from his nostrils, and devouring fire from his mouth; coals blazed out from him.
He bent the heavens and came down, with thick darkness under his feet.
He rode on a cherub and flew; he swooped on the wings of the wind.
He made darkness his hiding place, his shelter around him, dark waters, thick clouds of the skies.
Out of the brightness before him his clouds passed by, with hail and coals of fire.
The LORD thundered in the heavens; the Most High uttered his voice, with hail and coals of fire.
He sent out his arrows and scattered them, many lightning bolts, and threw them into confusion.
The channels of the waters were seen; the foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, LORD, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.
He reached down from on high and took me; he drew me out of many waters.
He rescued me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me, for they were too strong for me.
They confronted me on the day of my disaster, but the LORD was my support.
He brought me out into a wide place; he rescued me because he delighted in me.
The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands he repaid me.
For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and I have not done evil by turning from my God.
For all his rulings are before me, and his decrees I have not put away from me.
I was blameless before him, and I kept myself from my guilt.
So the LORD has repaid me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his sight.
With the faithful you show yourself faithful; with the blameless man you show yourself blameless.
With the pure you show yourself pure, but with the crooked you show yourself shrewd.
For you save a humble people, but haughty eyes you bring low.
For you light my lamp; the LORD my God lights up my darkness.
For with you I can charge against a troop; with my God I can leap over a wall.
This God, his way is perfect; the word of the LORD is refined. He is a shield to all who take refuge in him.
For who is God besides the LORD? And who is a rock except our God?
This God is the one who arms me with strength, and makes my way blameless.
He makes my feet like the feet of a deer, and sets me on my heights.
He trains my hands for war, so that my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
You have given me the shield of your salvation; your right hand supports me, and your gentleness has made me great.
You make a wide place for my steps beneath me, and my ankles have not slipped.
I pursued my enemies and overtook them; I did not turn back until they were finished off.
I crushed them, so that they could not rise; they fell beneath my feet.
You armed me with strength for battle; you made those who rose against me bow down beneath me.
You made my enemies turn their backs to me; those who hated me, I destroyed them.
They cried for help, but there was no one to save them; they cried to the LORD, but he did not answer them.
I beat them as fine as dust before the wind; I poured them out like the mud of the streets.
You rescued me from the strife of the people; you made me the head of nations. A people I did not know now serve me.
As soon as they hear of me, they obey me; foreigners come cringing to me.
Foreigners lose heart, and they come trembling out of their strongholds.
The LORD lives! Blessed be my rock! Exalted be the God of my salvation,
the God who grants me vengeance and subdues peoples under me,
who rescues me from my enemies. You lift me high above those who rise against me; you rescue me from violent men.
So I will praise you, LORD, among the nations, and sing praises to your name.
He gives great victories to his king; he shows faithful love to his anointed, to David and his offspring forever."
For the director. A psalm of David.
The heavens declare the glory of God; the dome of the sky proclaims the work of his hands.
Day after day they pour out speech; night after night they make knowledge known.
There is no speech, there are no words; their voice is not heard.
Yet their line goes out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In the heavens he has set a tent for the sun,
which comes out like a bridegroom from his chamber, and rejoices like a champion to run the course.
It rises at one end of the heavens and makes its circuit to the other end; nothing is hidden from its heat.
The law of the LORD is perfect, restoring the soul; the statutes of the LORD are trustworthy, making the simple wise.
The precepts of the LORD are right, giving joy to the heart; the command of the LORD is pure, giving light to the eyes.
The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring forever; the rulings of the LORD are true, and righteous altogether.
They are more desirable than gold, than much fine gold; they are sweeter than honey, than honey dripping from the comb.
By them your servant is warned; in keeping them there is great reward.
Who can discern his own errors? Clear me from hidden faults.
Keep your servant also from willful sins; do not let them rule over me. Then I will be blameless, and innocent of great wrongdoing.
May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing to you, LORD, my rock and my redeemer.
For the director. A psalm of David.
May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble; may the name of the God of Jacob keep you safe.
May he send you help from the sanctuary, and support you from Zion.
May he remember all your offerings, and accept your burnt offering. Selah.
May he give you what your heart desires, and fulfill all your plans.
We will shout for joy at your victory, and raise our banners in the name of our God. May the LORD fulfill all your requests.
Now I know that the LORD saves his anointed; he will answer him from his holy heaven with the saving might of his right hand.
Some trust in chariots and some in horses, but we call on the name of the LORD our God.
They collapse and fall, but we rise and stand firm.
LORD, save! May the king answer us on the day we call.
For the director. A psalm of David.
LORD, the king rejoices in your strength; how greatly he exults in your salvation!
You have given him his heart's desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah.
For you meet him with rich blessings; you set a crown of fine gold on his head.
He asked you for life, and you gave it to him, length of days forever and ever.
His glory is great through your salvation; you lay splendor and majesty on him.
For you make him most blessed forever; you make him glad with the joy of your presence.
For the king trusts in the LORD, and through the faithful love of the Most High he will not be shaken.
Your hand will find all your enemies; your right hand will find those who hate you.
You will make them like a blazing furnace when you appear. The LORD will swallow them up in his anger, and fire will consume them.
You will destroy their offspring from the earth, their descendants from among human beings.
Though they plan evil against you and devise schemes, they will not succeed.
For you will make them turn their backs when you aim your bows at their faces.
Be exalted, LORD, in your strength! We will sing and praise your might.
For the director. According to "The Doe of the Dawn". A psalm of David.
My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from saving me, so far from the words of my groaning?
My God, I cry out by day, but you do not answer, and by night, but I find no rest.
Yet you are holy, enthroned on the praises of Israel.
In you our ancestors trusted; they trusted, and you rescued them.
To you they cried out and were saved; in you they trusted and were not put to shame.
But I am a worm and not a man, scorned by everyone, despised by the people.
All who see me mock me; they sneer at me and shake their heads:
"Commit yourself to the LORD! Let him rescue him; let him deliver him, since he delights in him!"
Yet you are the one who brought me out of the womb, who made me feel safe at my mother's breasts.
On you I was cast from birth; from my mother's womb you have been my God.
Do not be far from me, for trouble is near, and there is no one to help.
Many bulls surround me; strong bulls of Bashan encircle me.
They open their mouths wide against me, like a ravening and roaring lion.
I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint. My heart has become like wax; it melts within me.
My strength is dried up like a piece of broken pottery, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth; you lay me in the dust of death.
For dogs surround me; a band of evildoers encircles me. Like a lion they attack my hands and my feet.
I can count all my bones; they stare and gloat over me.
They divide my clothes among them, and for my garment they cast lots.
But you, LORD, do not be far away; my strength, come quickly to help me.
Rescue my life from the sword, my only life from the power of the dog.
Save me from the mouth of the lion, from the horns of the wild oxen. You have answered me!
I will tell of your name to my brothers; in the midst of the assembly I will praise you.
You who fear the LORD, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, honor him! Stand in awe of him, all you descendants of Israel!
For he has not despised or scorned the suffering of the afflicted; he has not hidden his face from him, but when he cried to him for help, he heard.
From you comes my praise in the great assembly; I will fulfill my vows before those who fear him.
The humble will eat and be satisfied; those who seek the LORD will praise him. May your hearts live forever!
All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the LORD, and all the families of the nations will bow down before you.
For kingship belongs to the LORD, and he rules over the nations.
All the prosperous of the earth will eat and bow down; all who go down to the dust will kneel before him, those who cannot keep themselves alive.
Descendants will serve him; people will tell of the Lord to the next generation.
They will come and proclaim his righteousness to a people yet to be born: he has done it!
A psalm of David. The LORD is my shepherd; I have everything I need.
He lets me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside quiet waters.
He restores my life. He guides me along the right paths for the sake of his name.
Even when I walk through the darkest valley, I will fear no harm, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
You spread a table for me in front of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows.
Surely goodness and faithful love will follow me all the days of my life, and I will live in the house of the LORD for all my days.
Of David. A psalm. The earth is the LORD's, and everything in it, the world and those who live in it.
For he founded it on the seas, and established it on the rivers.
Who may go up the mountain of the LORD? Who may stand in his holy place?
The one who has clean hands and a pure heart, who has not lifted up my soul to what is false, and has not sworn deceitfully.
He will receive blessing from the LORD, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.
Such is the generation of those who seek him, who seek your face, Jacob. Selah.
Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you ancient doors, so that the King of glory may come in.
Who is this King of glory? The LORD, strong and mighty, the LORD, mighty in battle!
Lift up your heads, you gates! Lift them up, you ancient doors, so that the King of glory may come in.
Who is he, this King of glory? The LORD of Armies, he is the King of glory! Selah.
Of David. To you, LORD, I lift up my soul.
My God, in you I trust; do not let me be put to shame; do not let my enemies triumph over me.
No one who waits for you will be put to shame; those who are treacherous without cause will be put to shame.
Make your ways known to me, LORD; teach me your paths.
Lead me in your truth and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation; for you I wait all day long.
Remember your compassion, LORD, and your faithful love, for they have been from of old.
Do not remember the sins of my youth or my offenses; according to your faithful love remember me, for the sake of your goodness, LORD.
The LORD is good and upright; so he teaches sinners the way.
He leads the humble in what is right, and teaches the humble his way.
All the paths of the LORD are faithful love and faithfulness for those who keep his covenant and his statutes.
For the sake of your name, LORD, forgive my guilt, for it is great.
Who is the one who fears the LORD? He will teach him the way he should choose.
He himself will live in prosperity, and his offspring will inherit the land.
The close counsel of the LORD is for those who fear him, and he makes his covenant known to them.
My eyes are always on the LORD, for he will free my feet from the net.
Turn to me and be gracious to me, for I am lonely and afflicted.
The troubles of my heart have multiplied; bring me out of my distress.
See my affliction and my trouble, and forgive all my sins.
See how many my enemies are, and how they hate me with violent hatred.
Guard my life and rescue me; do not let me be put to shame, for I take refuge in you.
May integrity and uprightness protect me, for I wait for you.
Redeem Israel, God, from all its troubles.
Of David. Judge me, LORD, for I have walked in my integrity; I have trusted in the LORD without wavering.
Test me, LORD, and try me; refine my heart and my mind.
For your faithful love is before my eyes, and I have walked in your faithfulness.
I do not sit with deceitful people, nor do I go with hypocrites.
I hate the assembly of evildoers, and I will not sit with the wicked.
I wash my hands in innocence, and go around your altar, LORD,
making thanksgiving heard aloud, and telling of all your wonderful deeds.
LORD, I love the house where you live, the place where your glory dwells.
Do not sweep me away with sinners, or my life with the bloodthirsty,
in whose hands are evil schemes, and whose right hands are full of bribes.
But I walk in my integrity; redeem me and be gracious to me.
My foot stands on level ground; in the great assemblies I will bless the LORD.
Of David. The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
When evildoers come near me to devour my flesh, my adversaries and my enemies, it is they who stumble and fall.
Though an army camps against me, my heart will not fear; though war rises against me, even then I will be confident.
One thing I have asked of the LORD; this I will seek: to live in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to gaze on the beauty of the LORD, and to seek him in his temple.
For he will hide me in his shelter in the day of trouble; he will conceal me under the cover of his tent; he will set me high on a rock.
And now my head will be lifted up above my enemies around me, and I will offer sacrifices in his tent with shouts of joy; I will sing and make music to the LORD.
Hear, LORD, when I call aloud; be gracious to me and answer me.
My heart says to you, "Seek my face!" Your face, LORD, I will seek.
Do not hide your face from me; do not turn your servant away in anger. You have been my help; do not reject me or abandon me, God of my salvation.
Though my father and my mother abandon me, the LORD will take me in.
Teach me your way, LORD, and lead me on a level path, because of those who lie in wait for me.
Do not hand me over to the will of my adversaries, for false witnesses have risen against me, breathing out violence.
If I had not believed that I would see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living!
Wait for the LORD; be strong, and let your heart take courage. Wait for the LORD!
Of David. To you, LORD, I call; my rock, do not be deaf to me, for if you are silent to me, I will become like those who go down to the pit.
Hear the sound of my pleas for mercy when I cry to you for help, when I lift up my hands toward your holy inner sanctuary.
Do not drag me away with the wicked, with the evildoers, who speak peace with their neighbors while evil is in their hearts.
Repay them according to their deeds, according to the evil of their actions. Repay them according to the work of their hands; give back to them what they deserve.
Because they do not understand the deeds of the LORD or the work of his hands, he will tear them down and not build them up.
Blessed be the LORD, for he has heard the sound of my pleas for mercy.
The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in him, and I am helped. My heart exults, and with my song I will give thanks to him.
The LORD is their strength; he is a saving stronghold for his anointed.
Save your people and bless your inheritance; be their shepherd and carry them forever.
A psalm of David. Ascribe to the LORD, you heavenly beings, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
Ascribe to the LORD the glory due his name; worship the LORD in the splendor of holiness.
The voice of the LORD is over the waters; the God of glory thunders, the LORD, over the mighty waters.
The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is majestic.
The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars; the LORD breaks the cedars of Lebanon.
He makes Lebanon skip like a calf, and Sirion like a young wild ox.
The voice of the LORD strikes with flames of fire.
The voice of the LORD shakes the wilderness; the LORD shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.
The voice of the LORD makes the deer give birth, and strips the forests bare, and in his temple everyone says, "Glory!"
The LORD sat enthroned over the flood; the LORD sits enthroned as King forever.
May the LORD give strength to his people; may the LORD bless his people with peace.
A psalm. A song for the dedication of the house. Of David.
I will exalt you, LORD, for you have drawn me up, and have not let my enemies rejoice over me.
LORD my God, I cried to you for help, and you healed me.
LORD, you brought up my life from Sheol; you kept me alive, so that I did not go down to the pit.
Sing praises to the LORD, you his faithful ones; give thanks to his holy name.
For his anger lasts only a moment, but his favor for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
As for me, I said when I was at ease, "I will never be shaken."
LORD, by your favor you made my mountain stand strong. You hid your face, and I was terrified.
To you, LORD, I called; to the Lord I pleaded for mercy:
"What profit is there in my blood, if I go down to the pit? Will the dust praise you? Will it proclaim your faithfulness?
Hear, LORD, and be gracious to me! LORD, be my helper!"
You have turned my mourning into dancing; you have taken off my sackcloth and clothed me with joy,
so that my whole being may sing praises to you and not be silent. LORD my God, I will give thanks to you forever.
For the director. A psalm of David.
In you, LORD, I take refuge; never let me be put to shame; in your righteousness rescue me.
Turn your ear to me; rescue me quickly. Be a rock of refuge for me, a strong fortress to save me.
For you are my rock and my fortress; for the sake of your name lead me and guide me.
Bring me out of the net that they have hidden for me, for you are my refuge.
Into your hand I commit my spirit; you have redeemed me, LORD, faithful God.
I hate those who cling to worthless idols, but I trust in the LORD.
I will rejoice and be glad in your faithful love, because you have seen my affliction; you have known the distress of my soul.
You have not handed me over to the enemy; you have set my feet in a wide place.
Be gracious to me, LORD, for I am in distress; my eye wastes away with grief, my soul and my body too.
For my life is spent with sorrow, and my years with groaning. My strength fails because of my guilt, and my bones waste away.
Because of all my adversaries I have become a disgrace, especially to my neighbors, and a dread to my acquaintances; those who see me in the street flee from me.
I am forgotten like a dead man, out of mind; I have become like a broken pot.
For I hear the whispering of many, terror on every side, as they plot together against me; they scheme to take my life.
But I trust in you, LORD; I say, "You are my God."
My times are in your hand; rescue me from the hand of my enemies and from those who pursue me.
Let your face shine on your servant; save me in your faithful love.
LORD, do not let me be put to shame, for I call on you. Let the wicked be put to shame; let them be silent in Sheol.
Let lying lips be silenced, which speak arrogantly against the righteous with pride and contempt.
How great is your goodness, which you have stored up for those who fear you, which you have shown to those who take refuge in you, in the sight of all people!
You hide them in the shelter of your presence from human plots; you keep them safe in a shelter from accusing tongues.
Blessed be the LORD, for he has shown me the wonder of his faithful love in a city under siege.
As for me, I said in my alarm, "I am cut off from your sight." But you heard the sound of my pleas for mercy when I cried to you for help.
Love the LORD, all you his faithful ones! The LORD protects the loyal, but repays in full the one who acts with pride.
Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in the LORD.
Of David. A maskil. Happy is the one whose offense is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
Happy is the person to whom the LORD does not count guilt, and in whose spirit there is no deceit.
When I kept silent, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.
For day and night your hand was heavy on me; my strength was dried up as in the heat of summer. Selah.
I made my sin known to you, and I did not cover up my guilt. I said, "I will confess my offenses to the LORD," and you forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah.
So let everyone who is faithful pray to you while you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they will not reach him.
You are my hiding place; you protect me from trouble; you surround me with shouts of deliverance. Selah.
I will instruct you and teach you in the way you should go; I will counsel you with my eye on you.
Do not be like a horse or a mule, without understanding, which must be held in with bit and bridle, or it will not come near you.
Many are the pains of the wicked, but the one who trusts in the LORD is surrounded by faithful love.
Rejoice in the LORD and be glad, you righteous; shout for joy, all you upright in heart.
Shout for joy in the LORD, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.
Give thanks to the LORD with the lyre; make music to him with a ten-stringed harp.
Sing to him a new song; play skillfully, with shouts of joy.
For the word of the LORD is upright, and all his work is done in faithfulness.
He loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of the faithful love of the LORD.
By the word of the LORD the heavens were made, and all their host by the breath of his mouth.
He gathers the waters of the sea as in a heap; he puts the deep waters in storehouses.
Let all the earth fear the LORD; let all who live in the world stand in awe of him.
For he spoke, and it came to be; he commanded, and it stood firm.
The LORD frustrates the plans of the nations; he thwarts the purposes of the peoples.
The plans of the LORD stand forever, the purposes of his heart through all generations.
Happy is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people he has chosen as his inheritance.
From heaven the LORD looks down; he sees all human beings.
From the place where he sits enthroned he watches all who live on the earth.
He forms the hearts of them all; he understands all their deeds.
A king is not saved by a great army; a warrior is not rescued by great strength.
A horse is a false hope for victory; for all its great strength it cannot save.
See, the eye of the LORD is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his faithful love,
to rescue them from death and keep them alive in famine.
We wait for the LORD; he is our help and our shield.
For in him our heart rejoices, because we trust in his holy name.
May your faithful love be on us, LORD, as we hope in you.
Of David, when he changed his behavior before Abimelech, who drove him out, and he went away.
I will bless the LORD at all times; his praise will always be in my mouth.
My soul will boast in the LORD; let the humble hear and be glad.
Magnify the LORD with me; let us exalt his name together.
I sought the LORD, and he answered me; he rescued me from all my fears.
Those who looked to him were radiant, and their faces will never be ashamed.
This afflicted man called, and the LORD heard, and saved him from all his troubles.
The angel of the LORD camps around those who fear him, and rescues them.
Taste and see that the LORD is good. Happy is the one who takes refuge in him.
Fear the LORD, you his holy ones, for those who fear him lack nothing.
Young lions may go hungry and starve, but those who seek the LORD lack no good thing.
Come, children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
Who is the one who delights in life, and loves many days to see good?
Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from speaking deceit.
Turn away from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.
The eyes of the LORD are on the righteous, and his ears are turned to their cry for help.
The face of the LORD is against those who do evil, to cut off the memory of them from the earth.
They cry out, and the LORD hears, and rescues them from all their troubles.
The LORD is near to the brokenhearted, and saves those who are crushed in spirit.
Many are the troubles of the righteous, but the LORD rescues him from them all.
He guards all his bones; not one of them will be broken.
Evil will kill the wicked, and those who hate the righteous will be condemned.
The LORD redeems the life of his servants; none who take refuge in him will be condemned.
Of David. Contend, LORD, with those who contend with me; fight against those who fight against me.
Take hold of shield and buckler, and rise up to help me.
Draw the spear and the battle-axe against those who pursue me. Say to me, "I am your salvation."
Let those who seek my life be put to shame and disgraced; let those who plan harm against me be turned back and confounded.
Let them be like chaff before the wind, with the angel of the LORD driving them away.
Let their way be dark and slippery, with the angel of the LORD pursuing them.
For without cause they hid their net for me in a pit; without cause they dug it for my life.
Let ruin come on him unawares; let the net he hid catch him; let him fall into it, to his ruin.
Then my soul will rejoice in the LORD and delight in his salvation.
All my bones will say, "LORD, who is like you? You rescue the afflicted from those too strong for them, the afflicted and the needy from those who rob them."
Malicious witnesses rise up; they question me about things I do not know.
They repay me evil for good, leaving my soul bereaved.
But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth; I humbled myself with fasting, and I prayed with my head bowed on my chest.
I went about as though for my friend or my brother; I bowed down in mourning, like one who mourns for his mother.
But when I stumbled, they rejoiced and gathered; attackers gathered against me, people I did not know; they tore at me without ceasing.
Like godless people mocking at a feast, they gnashed their teeth at me.
Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my life from their ravages, my only life from the lions.
I will give thanks to you in the great assembly; among a mighty throng I will praise you.
Do not let those who are wrongfully my enemies gloat over me; do not let those who hate me without cause wink their eyes in malice.
For they do not speak peace, but devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land.
They open their mouths wide against me; they say, "Aha! Aha! Our eyes have seen it!"
You have seen it, LORD; do not be silent. Lord, do not be far from me.
Wake up! Rouse yourself to defend me, my God and my Lord, to plead my cause!
Judge me according to your righteousness, LORD my God, and do not let them gloat over me.
Do not let them say in their hearts, "Aha, just what we wanted!" Do not let them say, "We have swallowed him up."
Let those who rejoice at my misfortune be put to shame and confounded together; let those who exalt themselves over me be clothed with shame and disgrace.
Let those who delight in my vindication shout for joy and be glad; let them say always, "Great is the LORD, who delights in the well-being of his servant!"
Then my tongue will tell of your righteousness, of your praise all day long.
For the director. Of the servant of the LORD, of David.
Rebellion speaks to the wicked deep in my heart: there is no fear of God before his eyes.
For it flatters him in his own eyes, that his guilt will not be found out and hated.
The words of his mouth are wickedness and deceit; he has stopped acting wisely and doing good.
He plans wickedness on his bed; he sets himself on a path that is not good; he does not reject evil.
LORD, your faithful love reaches to the heavens, your faithfulness to the clouds.
Your righteousness is like the mighty mountains, your judgments like the great deep. LORD, you save humans and animals alike.
How precious is your faithful love, God! Human beings take refuge in the shadow of your wings.
They feast on the abundance of your house, and you give them drink from your river of delights.
For with you is the fountain of life; in your light we see light.
Continue your faithful love to those who know you, and your righteousness to the upright in heart.
Do not let the foot of the proud come against me, or the hand of the wicked drive me away.
There the evildoers lie fallen; they are thrust down and cannot rise.
Of David. Do not fret because of evildoers; do not envy those who do wrong.
For like grass they will soon wither, and like green plants they will fade.
Trust in the LORD and do good; live in the land and cultivate faithfulness.
Delight yourself in the LORD, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
Commit your way to the LORD; trust in him, and he will act.
He will make your righteousness shine like the light, and your justice like the noonday sun.
Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for him. Do not fret because of the one who prospers in his way, the one who carries out evil schemes.
Stop being angry and abandon your rage; do not fret: it leads only to evil.
For evildoers will be cut off, but those who wait for the LORD, they will inherit the land.
Yet a little while and the wicked will be no more; you will look closely at his place, and he will not be there.
But the humble will inherit the land and delight in abundant peace.
The wicked plots against the righteous and gnashes his teeth at him.
The Lord laughs at him, for he sees that his day is coming.
The wicked draw the sword and bend their bow to bring down the afflicted and the needy, to slaughter those whose way is upright.
Their sword will enter their own heart, and their bows will be broken.
Better is the little that the righteous has than the wealth of many wicked.
For the arms of the wicked will be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.
The LORD knows the days of the blameless, and their inheritance will last forever.
They will not be put to shame in evil times; in days of famine they will have plenty.
But the wicked will perish; the enemies of the LORD are like the glory of the pastures: they vanish; like smoke they vanish.
The wicked borrows and does not repay, but the righteous is generous and gives.
For those whom he blesses will inherit the land, but those whom he curses will be cut off.
A man's steps are made firm by the LORD, and he delights in his way.
Though he falls, he will not be thrown down, for the LORD holds his hand.
I have been young and now I am old, yet I have not seen the righteous abandoned, or his children begging for bread.
He is always generous and lends, and his children become a blessing.
Turn away from evil and do good, and you will live in the land forever.
For the LORD loves justice and will not abandon his faithful ones. They will be kept safe forever, but the children of the wicked will be cut off.
The righteous will inherit the land and live in it forever.
The mouth of the righteous utters wisdom, and his tongue speaks justice.
The law of his God is in his heart; his steps do not slip.
The wicked watches for the righteous and seeks to kill him.
The LORD will not abandon him to his power, or let him be condemned when he is brought to trial.
Wait for the LORD and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land; you will see it when the wicked are cut off.
I have seen a wicked and ruthless man, spreading himself like a luxuriant tree in its native soil.
But he passed away, and look, he was gone; I searched for him, but he could not be found.
Watch the blameless and observe the upright, for there is a future for the person of peace.
But rebels will be destroyed altogether; the future of the wicked will be cut off.
The salvation of the righteous comes from the LORD; he is their stronghold in time of trouble.
The LORD helps them and rescues them; he rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they take refuge in him.
A psalm of David. To bring to remembrance.
LORD, do not rebuke me in your anger, or discipline me in your wrath.
For your arrows have sunk into me, and your hand has come down on me.
There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation; there is no health in my bones because of my sin.
For my guilt has gone over my head; like a heavy burden it is too heavy for me.
My wounds stink and fester because of my foolishness.
I am bent over and bowed down greatly; all day long I go about in mourning.
For my sides are filled with burning, and there is no soundness in my flesh.
I am numb and badly crushed; I groan because of the turmoil of my heart.
Lord, all my longing is before you; my sighing is not hidden from you.
My heart pounds, my strength fails me; even the light of my eyes has gone from me.
My friends and companions stand aloof from my affliction; my neighbors stand far off.
Those who seek my life lay snares; those who seek my harm speak of ruin and plot deceit all day long.
But I am like a deaf man who does not hear, like a mute man who does not open his mouth.
I have become like a man who does not hear, in whose mouth there are no arguments.
For in you, LORD, I hope; you will answer, Lord my God.
For I said, "Do not let them gloat over me, who exalt themselves over me when my foot slips."
For I am ready to fall, and my pain is always before me.
I confess my guilt; I am troubled by my sin.
My enemies are full of life and strong; many are those who hate me wrongfully.
Those who repay evil for good accuse me because I pursue good.
Do not abandon me, LORD; my God, do not be far from me.
Come quickly to help me, Lord, my salvation.
For the director. For Jeduthun. A psalm of David.
I said, "I will guard my ways, so that I do not sin with my tongue; I will keep a muzzle on my mouth as long as the wicked are in my presence."
I was silent and still; I kept quiet, even from good, and my pain grew worse.
My heart grew hot within me; as I mused, a fire burned. Then I spoke with my tongue:
"LORD, let me know my end, and what is the measure of my days; let me know how fleeting I am.
See, you have made my days a few handbreadths, and my lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every human being, however firmly he stands, is only a breath. Selah.
Surely everyone goes about like a shadow; surely they are in turmoil for nothing. He heaps up wealth and does not know who will gather it.
And now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.
Rescue me from all my offenses; do not make me the scorn of fools.
I am silent; I do not open my mouth, for it is you who have done this.
Remove your blow from me; I am worn out by the hostility of your hand.
When you discipline someone with rebukes for guilt, you consume like a moth what is dear to him. Surely every human being is only a breath. Selah.
Hear my prayer, LORD, and listen to my cry for help; do not be silent at my tears. For I am a foreigner with you, a temporary resident, like all my ancestors.
Look away from me, so that I may smile again, before I go away and am no more."
For the director. Of David. A psalm.
I waited patiently for the LORD; he turned to me and heard my cry for help.
He drew me up from the pit of destruction, out of the miry clay; he set my feet on a rock and made my steps secure.
He put a new song in my mouth, a song of praise to our God. Many will see and fear, and will trust in the LORD.
Happy is the one who makes the LORD his trust, who does not turn to the proud, or to those who go astray after lies.
Many are the wonders you have done, LORD my God, and your plans for us; no one can compare with you. If I would proclaim them and speak of them, they are too many to count.
Sacrifice and offering you did not desire, but you have opened my ears; burnt offering and sin offering you did not ask for.
Then I said, "Here I am, I have come; in the scroll of the book it is written about me.
I delight to do your will, my God; your law is within my heart."
I have proclaimed the good news of righteousness in the great assembly. See, I do not hold back my lips, LORD, as you know.
I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart; I have spoken of your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your faithful love and your truth from the great assembly.
You, LORD, will not withhold your compassion from me; your faithful love and your truth will always protect me.
For evils without number have surrounded me; my sins have overtaken me, and I cannot see. They are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart fails me.
Be pleased, LORD, to rescue me; LORD, come quickly to help me.
Let those who seek my life, to sweep it away, be put to shame and confounded together; let those who delight in my harm be turned back and disgraced.
Let those who say to me, "Aha! Aha!" be appalled because of their shame.
But let all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you; let those who love your salvation say always, "Great is the LORD!"
As for me, I am afflicted and needy; may the Lord think of me. You are my help and my deliverer; my God, do not delay.
For the director. A psalm of David.
Happy is the one who considers the poor; in the day of trouble the LORD will rescue him.
The LORD will protect him and keep him alive; he will be called happy in the land. Do not hand him over to the will of his enemies!
The LORD will sustain him on his sickbed; in his illness you restore him to health.
As for me, I said, "LORD, be gracious to me; heal me, for I have sinned against you."
My enemies speak evil of me: "When will he die, and his name perish?"
When one of them comes to see me, he speaks empty words, while his heart gathers up mischief; he goes out and tells it abroad.
All who hate me whisper together against me; they imagine the worst for me:
"A deadly thing has been poured into him; now that he lies down, he will not rise again."
Even my close friend, whom I trusted, who ate my bread, has lifted up his heel against me.
But you, LORD, be gracious to me and raise me up, so that I may repay them.
By this I know that you delight in me: that my enemy does not shout in triumph over me.
As for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.
Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Amen and Amen.
For the director. A maskil of the sons of Korah.
As a deer longs for streams of water, so my soul longs for you, God.
My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When may I come and appear before God?
My tears have been my food day and night, while people say to me all day long, "Where is your God?"
These things I remember as I pour out my soul: how I used to go along with the throng, leading them in procession to the house of God, with shouts of joy and thanksgiving, a crowd keeping festival.
Why are you downcast, my soul? Why are you in turmoil within me? Hope in God, for I will yet praise him for the saving help of his presence.
My God, my soul is downcast within me; so I remember you from the land of the Jordan and the heights of Hermon, from Mount Mizar.
Deep calls to deep at the roar of your waterfalls; all your breakers and your waves have swept over me.
By day the LORD commands his faithful love, and at night his song is with me, a prayer to the God of my life.
I say to God, my rock, "Why have you forgotten me? Why must I go about in mourning, oppressed by the enemy?"
As if my bones were being crushed, my adversaries taunt me, saying to me all day long, "Where is your God?"
Why are you downcast, my soul? Why are you in turmoil within me? Hope in God, for I will yet praise him, my saving help and my God.
Vindicate me, God, and plead my case against an unfaithful nation; rescue me from the deceitful and unjust.
For you are God my stronghold. Why have you rejected me? Why must I go about in mourning, oppressed by the enemy?
Send out your light and your truth; let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy mountain, to the place where you dwell.
Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my joy and my delight, and I will praise you with the lyre, God, my God.
Why are you downcast, my soul? Why are you in turmoil within me? Hope in God, for I will yet praise him, my saving help and my God.
For the director. Of the sons of Korah. A maskil.
God, we have heard with our own ears; our ancestors have told us the work you did in their days, in the days of old.
With your own hand you drove out nations, but them you planted; you brought disaster on peoples, but them you set free.
For it was not by their sword that they took the land, and their own arm did not give them victory; it was your right hand and your arm and the light of your face, because you delighted in them.
You are my King, God; command victories for Jacob.
Through you we gore our adversaries; through your name we trample those who rise up against us.
For I do not trust in my bow, and my sword does not save me.
But you have saved us from our adversaries, and you have put those who hate us to shame.
In God we have boasted all day long, and we will praise your name forever. Selah.
Yet you have rejected us and humiliated us; you no longer go out with our armies.
You make us turn back from the adversary, and those who hate us take plunder for themselves.
You hand us over like sheep to be eaten, and you have scattered us among the nations.
You sell your people for nothing; you make no profit from their price.
You make us a disgrace to our neighbors, the scorn and mockery of those around us.
You make us a byword among the nations; the peoples shake their heads at us.
All day long my disgrace is before me, and the shame of my face has covered me,
at the voice of the one who taunts and reviles, at the sight of the enemy and the avenger.
All this has come upon us, though we have not forgotten you or been false to your covenant.
Our hearts have not turned back, and our steps have not strayed from your path.
Yet you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with deep darkness.
If we had forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a foreign god,
would not God have searched this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.
Yet for your sake we are killed all day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.
Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Rouse yourself! Do not reject us forever.
Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?
For we have sunk down to the dust; our bodies cling to the ground.
Rise up and help us! Redeem us for the sake of your faithful love.
For the director. According to "Lilies". Of the sons of Korah. A maskil. A love song.
My heart overflows with a good theme; I speak my verses for the king; my tongue is the pen of a skillful scribe.
You are the most handsome of all human beings; grace has been poured on your lips; so God has blessed you forever.
Strap your sword on your thigh, mighty warrior, in your splendor and your majesty.
In your majesty ride on to victory for the cause of truth and humility and righteousness; let your right hand teach you awesome deeds.
Your arrows are sharp in the hearts of the king's enemies; peoples fall beneath you.
Your throne, God, is forever and ever; the scepter of your kingdom is a scepter of justice.
You love righteousness and hate wickedness; so God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your companions.
All your robes are fragrant with myrrh and aloes and cassia; from ivory palaces the music of strings makes you glad.
Daughters of kings are among your honored women; at your right hand stands the queen in gold of Ophir.
Listen, daughter, consider and turn your ear: forget your people and your father's house.
Then the king will desire your beauty. He is your lord, so bow down to him.
The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift; the richest of the people seek your favor.
The king's daughter is all glorious within; her clothing is woven with gold.
In embroidered robes she is led to the king; the young women, her companions, follow her; they are brought to you.
They are led in with gladness and rejoicing; they enter the palace of the king.
Your sons will take the place of your ancestors; you will make them princes throughout the land.
I will make your name remembered in every generation; so the peoples will praise you forever and ever.
For the director. Of the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. A song.
God is our refuge and strength, a help in trouble, always ready to be found.
So we will not fear, though the earth gives way, though the mountains topple into the heart of the seas,
though its waters roar and foam, and the mountains quake at its surging. Selah.
There is a river whose streams make glad the city of God, the holy dwelling place of the Most High.
God is in her midst; she will not be shaken. God will help her at the break of day.
Nations roar, kingdoms totter; he raises his voice, and the earth melts.
The LORD of Armies is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah.
Come, see the works of the LORD, the desolations he has brought on the earth.
He makes wars cease to the end of the earth; he breaks the bow and snaps the spear; he burns the chariots with fire.
"Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations; I will be exalted in the earth."
The LORD of Armies is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah.
For the director. Of the sons of Korah. A psalm.
Clap your hands, all you peoples; shout to God with loud songs of joy.
For the LORD, the Most High, is awesome, a great King over all the earth.
He subdues peoples under us, and nations under our feet.
He chose our inheritance for us, the pride of Jacob, whom he loves. Selah.
God has gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of the ram's horn.
Sing praises to God, sing praises; sing praises to our King, sing praises.
For God is the King of all the earth; sing praises with a skillful psalm.
God reigns over the nations; God sits on his holy throne.
The nobles of the peoples have gathered as the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God; he is highly exalted.
A song. A psalm of the sons of Korah.
Great is the LORD, and most worthy of praise, in the city of our God, his holy mountain.
Beautiful in its height, the joy of all the earth, is Mount Zion, the heights of Zaphon, the city of the great King.
God, in her citadels, has shown himself a fortress.
For see, the kings assembled; they advanced together.
They saw, and they were astounded; they were terrified and fled in haste.
Trembling seized them there, pain like a woman in labor.
With an east wind you shatter the ships of Tarshish.
As we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of the LORD of Armies, in the city of our God: God will establish it forever. Selah.
We ponder your faithful love, God, within your temple.
Like your name, God, your praise reaches to the ends of the earth; your right hand is full of righteousness.
Let Mount Zion rejoice; let the daughters of Judah be glad because of your judgments.
Walk around Zion, go all around her; count her towers.
Consider well her ramparts; pass through her citadels, so that you may tell the next generation
that this is God, our God, forever and ever. He will guide us until death.
For the director. Of the sons of Korah. A psalm.
Hear this, all you peoples; listen, all who live in the world,
both low and high, rich and poor together.
My mouth will speak wisdom, and the meditation of my heart will be understanding.
I will turn my ear to a proverb; I will set out my riddle to the music of the lyre.
Why should I be afraid in days of trouble, when the wickedness of those who dog my steps surrounds me,
those who trust in their wealth and boast of their great riches?
No one can ever ransom a brother, or pay God the price for his life.
For the ransom of their life is costly, and it will always fall short,
that one should live on forever and never see the pit.
For one sees that the wise die; the fool and the senseless perish together, and leave their wealth to others.
Their inner thought is that their houses will last forever, their dwellings for all generations; they have named lands after themselves.
But a human being in his splendor does not endure; he is like the animals that perish.
This is the way of those who are foolishly confident, and of those after them who delight in their words. Selah.
Like sheep they are appointed for Sheol; death will be their shepherd. The upright will rule over them in the morning, and their form will waste away in Sheol, far from its lofty dwelling.
But God will redeem my life from the power of Sheol, for he will take me. Selah.
Do not be afraid when someone grows rich, when the glory of his house increases;
for when he dies he will take nothing with him; his glory will not go down after him.
Though in his lifetime he congratulates himself, and people praise you when you do well for yourself,
he will go to the generation of his ancestors, who will never see the light.
A human being in his splendor, without understanding, is like the animals that perish.
A psalm of Asaph. The Mighty One, God, the LORD, has spoken and summoned the earth from the rising of the sun to its setting.
Out of Zion, perfect in beauty, God shines out.
Our God comes, and he will not keep silent; before him is a devouring fire, and around him a raging storm.
He calls to the heavens above, and to the earth, to judge his people:
"Gather to me my faithful ones, who made a covenant with me by sacrifice."
The heavens proclaim his righteousness, for God himself is judge. Selah.
"Listen, my people, and I will speak; Israel, I will testify against you: I am God, your God.
It is not for your sacrifices that I rebuke you, or for your burnt offerings, which are always before me.
I will not take a bull from your house, or goats from your pens.
For every animal of the forest is mine, the cattle on a thousand hills.
I know every bird of the mountains, and all that moves in the field is mine.
If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world and all that fills it are mine.
Do I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
Offer God a sacrifice of thanksgiving, and fulfill your vows to the Most High.
Call on me in the day of trouble; I will rescue you, and you will honor me."
But to the wicked God says, "What right have you to recite my decrees, or to take my covenant on your lips?
You hate discipline, and you throw my words behind you.
When you see a thief, you are pleased with him, and you throw in your lot with adulterers.
You let your mouth loose for evil, and your tongue harnesses deceit.
You sit and speak against your brother; you slander your own mother's son.
These things you have done, and I kept silent; you thought that I was just like you. But I will rebuke you, and lay out the case before your eyes.
Understand this, you who forget God, or I will tear you to pieces, with no one to rescue you.
Whoever offers a sacrifice of thanksgiving honors me; and to the one who keeps to the way, I will show the salvation of God."
For the director. A psalm of David,
when the prophet Nathan came to him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba.
Be gracious to me, God, according to your faithful love; according to your great compassion, blot out my transgressions.
Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
For I know my transgressions, and my sin is always before me.
Against you, you alone, have I sinned, and done what is evil in your sight, so that you are right when you speak, and blameless when you judge.
Indeed, I was born in iniquity, and in sin my mother conceived me.
Indeed, you desire truth in the inner being; in the hidden place you teach me wisdom.
Purify me from sin with hyssop, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
Let me hear joy and gladness; let the bones you have crushed rejoice.
Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all my iniquities.
Create in me a clean heart, God, and renew a steadfast spirit within me.
Do not cast me away from your presence, and do not take your holy spirit from me.
Restore to me the joy of your salvation, and sustain me with a willing spirit.
Then I will teach transgressors your ways, and sinners will return to you.
Rescue me from bloodguilt, God, God of my salvation, and my tongue will sing aloud of your righteousness.
Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will declare your praise.
For you do not delight in sacrifice, or I would give it; you take no pleasure in burnt offering.
The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit; a broken and crushed heart, God, you will not despise.
Do good to Zion in your favor; build up the walls of Jerusalem.
Then you will delight in right sacrifices, in burnt offerings and whole burnt offerings; then bulls will be offered on your altar.
For the director. A maskil of David,
when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, "David has come to the house of Ahimelech."
Why do you boast of evil, you mighty man? The faithful love of God lasts all day long.
Your tongue plots destruction like a sharpened razor, you worker of deceit.
You love evil more than good, lying more than speaking righteousness. Selah.
You love all words that devour, you deceitful tongue.
But God will break you down forever; he will snatch you up and tear you from your tent; he will uproot you from the land of the living. Selah.
The righteous will see and fear; they will laugh at him, saying,
"See, this is the man who would not make God his stronghold, but trusted in his great wealth, and grew strong by his destruction."
But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God; I trust in the faithful love of God forever and ever.
I will give thanks to you forever, because you have done it. I will hope in your name, for it is good, in the presence of your faithful ones.
For the director. According to Mahalath. A maskil of David.
The fool says in his heart, "There is no God." They are corrupt; they do detestable wrong; there is no one who does good.
God looks down from heaven on human beings, to see if there is anyone who understands, anyone who seeks God.
They have all turned back; together they have become corrupt. There is no one who does good, not even one.
Do they know nothing, the evildoers, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and do not call on God?
There they are, in great terror, where there was nothing to fear! For God has scattered the bones of those who besieged you; you have put them to shame, for God has rejected them.
Oh, that salvation for Israel would come from Zion! When God restores the fortunes of his people, let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad.
For the director. With stringed instruments. A maskil of David,
when the Ziphites came and said to Saul, "Is not David hiding among us?"
God, save me by your name, and vindicate me by your might.
God, hear my prayer; listen to the words of my mouth.
For strangers have risen against me, and ruthless men seek my life; they do not set God before them. Selah.
See, God is my helper; the Lord is the one who sustains my life.
He will repay with evil those who lie in wait for me. In your faithfulness, destroy them.
With a freewill offering I will sacrifice to you; I will give thanks to your name, LORD, for it is good.
For he has rescued me from every trouble, and my eye has looked in triumph on my enemies.
For the director. With stringed instruments. A maskil of David.
Listen to my prayer, God, and do not hide yourself from my plea for mercy.
Pay attention to me and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and I groan,
at the voice of the enemy, because of the pressure of the wicked. For they bring down trouble on me, and in anger they bear a grudge against me.
My heart writhes within me; the terrors of death have fallen on me.
Fear and trembling come upon me, and horror overwhelms me.
And I say, "Oh, that I had wings like a dove! I would fly away and be at rest.
See, I would flee far away; I would lodge in the wilderness. Selah.
I would hurry to find a shelter from the raging wind and the storm."
Confuse them, Lord, divide their tongues, for I see violence and strife in the city.
Day and night they go around it on its walls; wickedness and trouble are within it.
Destruction is within it; oppression and deceit never leave its square.
For it is not an enemy who taunts me, or I could bear it; it is not one who hates me who exalts himself against me, or I could hide from him.
But it is you, a man like myself, my companion and my close friend.
Together we used to share sweet counsel; we walked with the throng in the house of God.
Let death come on them by surprise; let them go down alive to Sheol, for evil is in their dwellings, in their midst.
As for me, I call to God, and the LORD will save me.
Evening and morning and at noon I complain and groan, and he hears my voice.
He redeems my life in safety from the battle against me, for many are against me.
God will hear and answer them, he who is enthroned from of old. Selah. They never change their ways, and they do not fear God.
He has stretched out his hands against his friends; he has violated his covenant.
His speech is smoother than butter, but war is in his heart; his words are softer than oil, but they are drawn swords.
Cast your burden on the LORD, and he will sustain you; he will never let the righteous be shaken.
But you, God, will bring them down to the pit of destruction; people of bloodshed and deceit will not live out half their days. But as for me, I will trust in you.
For the director. According to "The Silent Dove of Far-off Places". Of David. A miktam, when the Philistines seized him in Gath.
Be gracious to me, God, for a mere mortal hounds me; all day long an attacker oppresses me.
Those who lie in wait for me hound me all day long, for many fight against me proudly.
When I am afraid, I put my trust in you.
In God, whose word I praise, in God I trust; I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?
All day long they twist my words; all their thoughts are against me for evil.
They gather together, they lie in hiding; they watch my steps, as they wait to take my life.
Because of their wickedness, will they escape? In anger bring down the peoples, God.
You have counted my wanderings; put my tears in your bottle. Are they not in your book?
Then my enemies will turn back on the day I call. This I know: God is for me.
In God, whose word I praise, in the LORD, whose word I praise,
in God I trust; I will not be afraid. What can a human being do to me?
I am bound by vows to you, God; I will offer thanksgiving offerings to you.
For you have rescued my life from death, and my feet from stumbling, so that I may walk before God in the light of life.
For the director. According to "Do Not Destroy". Of David. A miktam, when he fled from Saul, in the cave.
Be gracious to me, God, be gracious to me, for in you my soul takes refuge; in the shadow of your wings I will take refuge until the destruction passes by.
I cry to God Most High, to God who fulfills his purpose for me.
He will send from heaven and save me; he will put to shame the one who hounds me. Selah. God will send out his faithful love and his faithfulness.
My soul is in the midst of lions; I lie down among those who breathe fire, human beings whose teeth are spears and arrows, whose tongue is a sharp sword.
Be exalted above the heavens, God; let your glory be over all the earth.
They set a net for my steps; my soul was bowed down. They dug a pit in my path; they have fallen into it themselves. Selah.
My heart is steadfast, God, my heart is steadfast; I will sing and make music.
Wake up, my glory! Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake the dawn.
I will give thanks to you among the peoples, Lord; I will sing praise to you among the nations.
For your faithful love is great, reaching to the heavens, and your faithfulness to the clouds.
Be exalted above the heavens, God; let your glory be over all the earth.
For the director. According to "Do Not Destroy". Of David. A miktam.
Do you indeed speak righteousness, you gods? Do you judge human beings fairly?
No, in your hearts you devise wrongs; on the earth you weigh out the violence of your hands.
The wicked go astray from the womb; liars wander off from birth.
Their venom is like the venom of a snake, like a deaf cobra that stops up its ear,
that will not listen to the voice of charmers, or of the most skillful caster of spells.
God, break the teeth in their mouths; tear out the fangs of the young lions, LORD.
Let them vanish like water that runs away; when he aims his arrows, let them be cut off.
Let them be like a snail that melts away as it goes, like a woman's stillborn child, that never sees the sun.
Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns, whether green or burning, he will sweep them away.
The righteous will rejoice when they see vengeance done; they will bathe their feet in the blood of the wicked.
And people will say, "Surely there is a reward for the righteous; surely there is a God who judges on the earth."
For the director. According to "Do Not Destroy". Of David. A miktam, when Saul sent men, and they watched the house in order to kill him.
Rescue me from my enemies, my God; protect me from those who rise up against me.
Rescue me from evildoers, and save me from bloodthirsty men.
For see, they lie in wait for my life; fierce men band together against me, not for any transgression or sin of mine, LORD.
For no guilt of mine they run and take up their positions. Rouse yourself to meet me, and see!
You, LORD God of Armies, God of Israel, wake up to punish all the nations; show no mercy to any treacherous evildoers. Selah.
They return at evening, howling like dogs, and prowl around the city.
See, they spew from their mouths; swords are on their lips, for they think, "Who will hear?"
But you, LORD, laugh at them; you mock all the nations.
Because of his strength, I will watch for you, for God is my fortress.
My faithful God will come to meet me; God will let me look in triumph on those who lie in wait for me.
Do not kill them, or my people will forget; make them wander by your power, and bring them down, Lord, our shield.
For the sin of their mouths, the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride, for the curses and the lies they speak.
Consume them in wrath, consume them until they are no more, so that they may know that God rules over Jacob, to the ends of the earth. Selah.
They return at evening, howling like dogs, and prowl around the city.
They wander about for food, and if they are not satisfied, they stay all night.
But I will sing of your strength; I will sing aloud of your faithful love in the morning. For you have been my fortress, a refuge in the day of my distress.
My Strength, I will sing praises to you, for God is my fortress, my faithful God.
For the director. According to "The Lily of the Testimony". A miktam of David, for teaching,
when he fought against Aram-naharaim and Aram-zobah, and when Joab returned and struck down twelve thousand of Edom in the Valley of Salt.
God, you have rejected us and broken us; you have been angry. Restore us!
You have made the land quake; you have split it open. Heal its cracks, for it is tottering.
You have made your people see hard times; you have given us wine to drink that makes us stagger.
You have set up a banner for those who fear you, for them to rally to, out of range of the bow. Selah.
So that those you love may be rescued, save by your right hand, and answer me.
God has spoken in his holiness: "I will exult; I will divide up Shechem, and measure out the Valley of Succoth.
Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is the helmet on my head; Judah is my scepter.
Moab is my washbasin; on Edom I throw my sandal. Philistia, shout aloud because of me!"
Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
Is it not you, God, who have rejected us? You no longer go out, God, with our armies.
Give us help against the adversary, for human help is worthless.
With God we will do valiantly; he will trample our adversaries.
For the director. With stringed instruments. Of David.
Hear my cry, God; listen to my prayer.
From the end of the earth I call to you, when my heart grows faint. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
For you have been my refuge, a strong tower against the enemy.
Let me live in your tent forever; let me take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah.
For you, God, have heard my vows; you have given the inheritance of those who fear your name.
Add days to the days of the king; may his years be like generation after generation.
May he sit enthroned forever before God; appoint faithful love and truth to guard him.
So I will sing praise to your name forever, as I fulfill my vows day after day.
For the director. According to Jeduthun. A psalm of David.
Truly my soul waits in silence for God; my salvation comes from him.
Truly he is my rock and my salvation, my fortress; I will not be greatly shaken.
How long will you all attack a man, to batter him down like a leaning wall, a tottering fence?
Truly they plan to topple him from his high place; they delight in lies. With their mouths they bless, but inwardly they curse. Selah.
Truly, my soul, wait in silence for God, for my hope comes from him.
Truly he is my rock and my salvation, my fortress; I will not be shaken.
My salvation and my glory rest on God; my strong rock, my refuge, is in God.
Trust in him at all times, you people; pour out your hearts before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.
Truly, human beings are only a breath; people of rank are a lie. Placed on the scales, they go up; together they weigh less than a breath.
Do not trust in extortion, or put empty hope in robbery; if wealth increases, do not set your heart on it.
Once God has spoken; twice I have heard this: that power belongs to God,
and faithful love belongs to you, Lord. For you repay each person according to what he has done.
A psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah.
God, you are my God; I seek you earnestly. My soul thirsts for you; my body longs for you, in a dry and weary land without water.
So I have gazed on you in the sanctuary, to see your power and your glory.
Because your faithful love is better than life, my lips will praise you.
So I will bless you as long as I live; in your name I will lift up my hands.
My soul will be satisfied as with the richest food, and my mouth will praise you with joyful lips.
When I remember you on my bed, I meditate on you through the watches of the night.
For you have been my help, and in the shadow of your wings I sing for joy.
My soul clings to you; your right hand holds me up.
But those who seek my life to destroy it will go down into the depths of the earth.
They will be handed over to the power of the sword; they will become food for jackals.
But the king will rejoice in God; all who swear by him will boast, for the mouths of those who speak lies will be stopped.
For the director. A psalm of David.
Hear my voice, God, in my complaint; protect my life from the terror of the enemy.
Hide me from the secret plots of evildoers, from the scheming throng of evildoers,
who sharpen their tongues like swords, and aim bitter words like arrows,
to shoot from hiding at the blameless; suddenly they shoot at him, and they have no fear.
They encourage one another in an evil plan; they talk of hiding snares; they say, "Who will see them?"
They devise injustices: "We have perfected a well-made plan!" For the inner thoughts and the heart of a man are deep.
But God will shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly they will be wounded.
They will be brought down, with their own tongues turned against them; all who see them will shake their heads.
Then all people will fear; they will proclaim the work of God and ponder what he has done.
Let the righteous rejoice in the LORD and take refuge in him; let all the upright in heart give praise.
For the director. A psalm of David. A song.
Praise waits for you in silence, God, in Zion, and to you vows will be fulfilled.
You who hear prayer, to you all flesh will come.
When iniquities overwhelm me, you atone for our transgressions.
Happy is the one you choose and bring near to live in your courts! We will be satisfied with the good things of your house, your holy temple.
With awesome deeds you answer us in righteousness, God of our salvation, the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas,
who sets the mountains firm by his strength, clothed with might,
who stills the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the tumult of the peoples.
Those who live at the ends of the earth are in awe at your signs; you make the lands of the morning and the evening shout for joy.
You care for the land and water it; you make it very rich. The stream of God is full of water; you provide their grain, for so you have prepared the land.
You drench its furrows, you level its ridges; you soften it with showers and bless its growth.
You crown the year with your goodness, and your tracks overflow with abundance.
The pastures of the wilderness overflow; the hills are clothed with joy.
The meadows are clothed with flocks, and the valleys are covered with grain; they shout for joy, yes, they sing.
For the director. A song. A psalm. Shout for joy to God, all the earth!
Sing praises to the glory of his name; make his praise glorious.
Say to God, "How awesome are your deeds! Because of your great power your enemies cringe before you.
All the earth bows down to you and sings praises to you; they sing praises to your name." Selah.
Come and see the works of God, awesome in his deeds toward human beings.
He turned the sea into dry land; they passed through the river on foot. There we rejoiced in him.
He rules by his might forever; his eyes keep watch on the nations. Let the rebellious not exalt themselves. Selah.
Bless our God, you peoples; let the sound of his praise be heard,
who has kept us among the living, and has not let our feet slip.
For you have tested us, God; you have refined us as silver is refined.
