The works of his hands are faithfulness and justice; all his precepts are trustworthy.
They are established forever and ever, made in faithfulness and uprightness.
He sent redemption to his people; he has commanded his covenant forever. Holy and awesome is his name.
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who practice them have good understanding. His praise endures forever.
Praise the LORD! Happy is the one who fears the LORD, who greatly delights in his commands.
His descendants will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.
Wealth and riches are in his house, and his righteousness endures forever.
Light dawns in the darkness for the upright; he is gracious, compassionate and righteous.
It goes well with the one who is generous and lends, who conducts his affairs with justice.
For he will never be shaken; the righteous will be remembered forever.
He is not afraid of bad news; his heart is steady, trusting in the LORD.
His heart is secure; he will not be afraid, until he looks in triumph on his adversaries.
He has scattered abroad; he has given to the needy. His righteousness endures forever; his horn will be lifted high in honor.
The wicked will see it and be angry; he will grind his teeth and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.
Praise the LORD! Praise, you servants of the LORD; praise the name of the LORD.
May the name of the LORD be blessed, from now on and forever.
From the rising of the sun to its setting, the name of the LORD is to be praised.
The LORD is high above all nations; his glory is above the heavens.
Who is like the LORD our God, who is enthroned on high,
who stoops down to look on the heavens and the earth?
He raises the poor from the dust, and lifts the needy from the ash heap,
to seat them with nobles, with the nobles of his people.
He gives the childless woman a home, as a happy mother of children. Praise the LORD!
When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign speech,
Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.
The sea looked and fled; the Jordan turned back.
The mountains skipped like rams, the hills like lambs.
What is wrong with you, sea, that you flee? Jordan, that you turn back?
You mountains, that you skip like rams? You hills, like lambs?
Tremble, earth, before the Lord, before the God of Jacob,
who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a spring of water.
Not to us, LORD, not to us, but to your name give glory, because of your faithful love, because of your faithfulness.
Why should the nations say, "Where, then, is their God?"
Our God is in the heavens; he does whatever he pleases.
Their idols are silver and gold, the work of human hands.
They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see.
They have ears, but cannot hear; they have noses, but cannot smell.
They have hands, but cannot feel; feet, but cannot walk; they make no sound in their throats.
Those who make them will become like them, and so will all who trust in them.
Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
House of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
The LORD has remembered us; he will bless. He will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.
He will bless those who fear the LORD, the small together with the great.
May the LORD give you increase, you and your children.
May you be blessed by the LORD, the maker of heaven and earth.
The heavens are the heavens of the LORD, but the earth he has given to human beings.
It is not the dead who praise the LORD, nor any who go down into silence.
But we will bless the LORD from now on and forever. Praise the LORD!
I love the LORD, for he hears my voice, my pleas for mercy.
Because he has turned his ear to me, I will call on him as long as I live.
The cords of death surrounded me; the distress of Sheol found me; I found trouble and sorrow.
Then I called on the name of the LORD: "Please, LORD, rescue my life!"
The LORD is gracious and righteous; our God is compassionate.
The LORD protects the simple; I was brought low, and he saved me.
Return to your rest, my soul, for the LORD has dealt generously with you.
For you have rescued my life from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
I kept faith, even when I said, "I am greatly afflicted."
I said in my alarm, "Everyone is a liar."
What can I give back to the LORD for all his goodness to me?
I will lift up the cup of salvation and call on the name of the LORD.
I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all his people.
Precious in the eyes of the LORD is the death of his faithful ones.
Please, LORD, truly I am your servant; I am your servant, the son of your female servant. You have loosed my bonds.
To you I will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving, and call on the name of the LORD.
I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all his people,
in the courts of the house of the LORD, in your midst, Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
Praise the LORD, all nations! Extol him, all peoples!
For great is his faithful love toward us, and the faithfulness of the LORD endures forever. Praise the LORD!
Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; his faithful love endures forever.
Let Israel say, "His faithful love endures forever."
Let the house of Aaron say, "His faithful love endures forever."
Let those who fear the LORD say, "His faithful love endures forever."
In my distress I called on the LORD; the LORD answered me and set me in a broad place.
The LORD is for me; I will not be afraid. What can anyone do to me?
The LORD is for me as my helper; I will look in triumph on those who hate me.
It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in human beings.
It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in nobles.
All the nations surrounded me; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
They surrounded me like bees; they died out like a fire of thorns. In the name of the LORD I cut them off.
You pushed me hard to make me fall, but the LORD helped me.
The LORD is my strength and my song; he has become my salvation.
The sound of joyful shouting and salvation is in the tents of the righteous: "The right hand of the LORD does mighty deeds!
The right hand of the LORD is lifted high; the right hand of the LORD does mighty deeds!"
I will not die, but live, and I will tell of the works of the LORD.
The LORD has disciplined me severely, but he has not given me over to death.
Open the gates of righteousness for me; I will enter through them and give thanks to the LORD.
This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous will enter through it.
I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.
The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
This was the LORD's doing, and it is marvelous in our eyes.
This is the day that the LORD has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.
Please, LORD, save us! Please, LORD, give us success!
Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the LORD! We bless you from the house of the LORD.
The LORD is God, and he has given us light. Bind the festival sacrifice with cords to the horns of the altar.
You are my God, and I will give thanks to you; my God, I will exalt you.
Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; his faithful love endures forever.
Happy are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the law of the LORD.
Happy are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with all their heart.
They do no wrong; they walk in his ways.
You have commanded your precepts, to be kept with all care.
Oh, that my ways were steady in keeping your decrees!
Then I would not be put to shame, when I look to all your commands.
I will give thanks to you with an upright heart, as I learn your righteous rulings.
I will keep your decrees; do not utterly forsake me.
How can a young man keep his path pure? By guarding it according to your word.
With all my heart I seek you; do not let me stray from your commands.
I have treasured your promise in my heart, so that I may not sin against you.
Blessed are you, LORD; teach me your decrees.
With my lips I recount all the rulings of your mouth.
I rejoice in the way of your statutes as much as in all riches.
I will meditate on your precepts and fix my eyes on your paths.
I will delight in your decrees; I will not forget your word.
Deal generously with your servant, so that I may live and keep your word.
Open my eyes, so that I may see wonderful things in your law.
I am a stranger on the earth; do not hide your commands from me.
My soul is crushed with longing for your rulings at all times.
You rebuke the arrogant, the accursed, who stray from your commands.
Take scorn and contempt away from me, for I keep your statutes.
Even though rulers sit and talk together against me, your servant meditates on your decrees.
Your statutes are my delight; they are my counselors.
My soul clings to the dust; give me life according to your word.
I told you of my ways, and you answered me; teach me your decrees.
Make me understand the way of your precepts, and I will meditate on your wonders.
My soul weeps from grief; raise me up according to your word.
Keep me from the way of falsehood, and graciously give me your law.
I have chosen the way of faithfulness; I have set your rulings before me.
I cling to your statutes; LORD, do not let me be put to shame.
I will run in the way of your commands, for you set my heart free.
Teach me, LORD, the way of your decrees, and I will keep it to the end.
Give me understanding, and I will keep your law and obey it with all my heart.
Lead me in the path of your commands, for I delight in it.
Turn my heart to your statutes, and not to selfish gain.
Turn my eyes away from looking at what is worthless; give me life in your way.
Confirm to your servant your promise, which is for those who fear you.
Turn away the disgrace that I dread, for your rulings are good.
See, I long for your precepts; in your righteousness give me life.
May your faithful love come to me, LORD, your salvation according to your promise.
Then I will have an answer for the one who taunts me, for I trust in your word.
Do not take the word of truth utterly out of my mouth, for I hope in your rulings.
I will keep your law continually, forever and ever.
I will walk about in freedom, for I have sought your precepts.
I will speak of your statutes before kings, and I will not be put to shame.
I will delight in your commands, which I love.
I will lift up my hands to your commands, which I love, and I will meditate on your decrees.
Remember your word to your servant, by which you have given me hope.
This is my comfort in my affliction: that your promise gives me life.
The arrogant mock me without restraint, but I do not turn away from your law.
I remember your rulings of old, LORD, and I take comfort.
Burning anger seizes me because of the wicked, who forsake your law.
Your decrees have been my songs in the house where I live as a stranger.
In the night I remember your name, LORD, and I keep your law.
This has been my lot: I have kept your precepts.
The LORD is my portion; I have promised to keep your words.
I have sought your favor with all my heart; be gracious to me according to your promise.
I have thought about my ways, and turned my feet to your statutes.
I hurry and do not delay to keep your commands.
The cords of the wicked are wrapped around me, but I do not forget your law.
At midnight I rise to give thanks to you for your righteous rulings.
I am a companion of all who fear you, of those who keep your precepts.
The earth is full of your faithful love, LORD; teach me your decrees.
You have dealt well with your servant, LORD, according to your word.
Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commands.
Before I was afflicted I went astray, but now I keep your promise.
You are good, and you do good; teach me your decrees.
The arrogant smear me with lies, but I keep your precepts with all my heart.
Their hearts are unfeeling, like fat, but I delight in your law.
It was good for me that I was afflicted, so that I might learn your decrees.
The law from your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
Your hands made me and formed me; give me understanding, so that I may learn your commands.
Those who fear you will see me and rejoice, for I hope in your word.
I know, LORD, that your rulings are righteous, and that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.
May your faithful love comfort me, according to your promise to your servant.
Let your compassion come to me, so that I may live, for your law is my delight.
Let the arrogant be put to shame, for they have wronged me with lies; but I will meditate on your precepts.
Let those who fear you turn to me, those who know your statutes.
May my heart be blameless in your decrees, so that I may not be put to shame.
My soul faints with longing for your salvation; I hope in your word.
My eyes fail, looking for your promise; I say, "When will you comfort me?"
For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke, yet I do not forget your decrees.
How many are the days of your servant? When will you bring judgment on those who persecute me?
The arrogant have dug pits for me, they who do not live by your law.
All your commands are faithful; they persecute me with lies; help me!
They have almost wiped me from the earth, but I have not forsaken your precepts.
In your faithful love give me life, and I will keep the statutes of your mouth.
Forever, LORD, your word stands firm in the heavens.
Your faithfulness endures from generation to generation; you established the earth, and it stands.
By your rulings they stand to this day, for all things are your servants.
If your law had not been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.
I will never forget your precepts, for by them you have given me life.
I am yours; save me, for I have sought your precepts.
The wicked lie in wait to destroy me, but I consider your statutes.
I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your command is exceedingly broad.
Oh, how I love your law! It is my meditation all day long.
Your commands make me wiser than my enemies, for they are always with me.
I have more insight than all my teachers, for your statutes are my meditation.
I understand more than the elders, for I keep your precepts.
I hold back my feet from every evil path, so that I may keep your word.
I do not turn aside from your rulings, for you yourself have taught me.
How sweet your promise is to my taste, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
From your precepts I gain understanding; so I hate every false path.
Your word is a lamp for my feet and a light for my path.
I have sworn an oath and confirmed it, to keep your righteous rulings.
I am severely afflicted; LORD, give me life according to your word.
Accept, LORD, the freewill offerings of my mouth, and teach me your rulings.
My life is always in my hand, yet I do not forget your law.
The wicked have set a trap for me, but I have not strayed from your precepts.
Your statutes are my inheritance forever; they are the joy of my heart.
I have set my heart on doing your decrees, forever, to the end.
I hate the double-minded, but I love your law.
You are my hiding place and my shield; I hope in your word.
Go away from me, you evildoers, so that I may keep the commands of my God.
Sustain me according to your promise, so that I may live; do not let me be put to shame in my hope.
Uphold me, so that I may be safe, and I will always have regard for your decrees.
You reject all who stray from your decrees, for their deceit is in vain.
You remove all the wicked of the earth like dross; so I love your statutes.
My flesh shudders in fear of you, and I am afraid of your rulings.
I have done what is just and right; do not abandon me to my oppressors.
Guarantee your servant's well-being; do not let the arrogant oppress me.
My eyes fail, looking for your salvation and for your righteous promise.
Deal with your servant according to your faithful love, and teach me your decrees.
I am your servant; give me understanding, so that I may know your statutes.
It is time for the LORD to act; they have broken your law.
Therefore I love your commands more than gold, more than fine gold.
Therefore I consider all the precepts right in everything; I hate every false path.
Your statutes are wonderful; so my soul keeps them.
The unfolding of your words gives light; it gives understanding to the simple.
I open my mouth and pant, for I long for your commands.
Turn to me and be gracious to me, as is your way with those who love your name.
Make my steps steady by your promise, and let no wickedness rule over me.
Redeem me from human oppression, so that I may keep your precepts.
Make your face shine on your servant, and teach me your decrees.
Streams of water flow down from my eyes, because they do not keep your law.
You are righteous, LORD, and your rulings are upright.
You have commanded your statutes in righteousness and in great faithfulness.
My zeal consumes me, because my adversaries forget your words.
Your promise is thoroughly refined, and your servant loves it.
I am small and despised, yet I do not forget your precepts.
Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and your law is truth.
Trouble and distress have found me, but your commands are my delight.
Your statutes are righteous forever; give me understanding, so that I may live.
I call with all my heart; answer me, LORD, and I will keep your decrees.
I call to you; save me, and I will keep your statutes.
I rise before dawn and cry for help; I hope in your word.
My eyes are awake before the watches of the night, so that I may meditate on your promise.
Hear my voice according to your faithful love; LORD, give me life according to your justice.
Those who pursue wicked schemes draw near; they are far from your law.
You are near, LORD, and all your commands are truth.
Long ago I learned from your statutes that you have established them forever.
Look on my affliction and rescue me, for I do not forget your law.
Plead my case and redeem me; give me life according to your promise.
Salvation is far from the wicked, for they do not seek your decrees.
Your compassion is great, LORD; give me life according to your rulings.
Many are my persecutors and my adversaries, but I do not turn away from your statutes.
I look on the treacherous with disgust, because they do not keep your promise.
See how I love your precepts! LORD, give me life according to your faithful love.
The sum of your word is truth, and every one of your righteous rulings endures forever.
Rulers persecute me without cause, but my heart stands in awe of your word.
I rejoice over your promise like one who finds great plunder.
I hate and detest falsehood, but I love your law.
Seven times a day I praise you for your righteous rulings.
Great peace have those who love your law; nothing makes them stumble.
I wait for your salvation, LORD, and I do your commands.
My soul keeps your statutes; I love them greatly.
I keep your precepts and your statutes, for all my ways are before you.
Let my cry come near to you, LORD; give me understanding according to your word.
Let my plea come before you; rescue me according to your promise.
Let my lips pour out praise, for you teach me your decrees.
Let my tongue sing of your promise, for all your commands are righteous.
Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.
I long for your salvation, LORD, and your law is my delight.
Let my soul live, and it will praise you; and let your rulings help me.
I have strayed like a lost sheep; seek your servant, for I do not forget your commands.
A song of ascents. To the LORD I called in my distress, and he answered me.
LORD, rescue me from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.
What will he give you, and what more will he do to you, you deceitful tongue?
A warrior's sharp arrows, with burning coals of the broom tree!
Woe is me, that I live as a stranger in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!
Too long I have lived with those who hate peace.
I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.
A song of ascents. I lift up my eyes to the mountains. Where does my help come from?
My help comes from the LORD, the maker of heaven and earth.
He will not let your foot slip; the one who guards you will not slumber.
Look, the one who guards Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
The LORD is the one who guards you; the LORD is your shade at your right hand.
The sun will not strike you by day, nor the moon by night.
The LORD will guard you from all harm; he will guard your life.
The LORD will guard your going out and your coming in, from now on and forever.
A song of ascents. Of David. I was glad when they said to me, "Let us go to the house of the LORD."
Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem.
Jerusalem, built as a city that is bound firmly together,
where the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, according to the statute given to Israel, to give thanks to the name of the LORD.
For there the thrones for judgment stand, the thrones of the house of David.
Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: "May those who love you be secure.
May there be peace within your walls, security within your fortresses."
For the sake of my brothers and my friends, I will say, "Peace be within you."
For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your good.
A song of ascents. To you I lift up my eyes, you who are enthroned in the heavens.
As the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a female servant look to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the LORD our God, until he is gracious to us.
Be gracious to us, LORD, be gracious to us, for we have had more than enough of contempt.
We have had more than enough of the scorn of those who are at ease, of the contempt of the proud.
A song of ascents. Of David. If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, let Israel now say,
if it had not been the LORD who was on our side when people rose up against us,
then they would have swallowed us alive, when their anger blazed against us;
then the waters would have swept us away; the torrent would have gone over us;
then the raging waters would have gone over us.
Blessed be the LORD, who has not given us as prey to their teeth.
We have escaped like a bird from the fowler's trap; the trap is broken, and we have escaped.
Our help is in the name of the LORD, the maker of heaven and earth.
A song of ascents. Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion, which cannot be shaken but stands firm forever.
As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his people, from now on and forever.
For the scepter of wickedness will not rest on the land allotted to the righteous, so that the righteous do not stretch out their hands to do wrong.
Do good, LORD, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts.
But those who turn aside to their crooked ways, the LORD will lead away with the evildoers. Peace be on Israel!
A song of ascents. When the LORD restored the fortunes of Zion, we were like those who dream.
Then our mouths were filled with laughter, and our tongues with shouts of joy. Then they said among the nations, "The LORD has done great things for them."
The LORD has done great things for us, and we were glad.
Restore our fortunes, LORD, like streams in the Negev.
Those who sow in tears will reap with shouts of joy.
The one who goes out weeping, carrying the seed to sow, will surely come back with shouts of joy, carrying his sheaves.
A song of ascents. Of Solomon. Unless the LORD builds the house, its builders labor over it in vain. Unless the LORD guards the city, the guard keeps watch in vain.
It is in vain that you rise up early and go late to rest, eating the bread of anxious toil; for he gives sleep to the one he loves.
Look, children are an inheritance from the LORD, the fruit of the womb a reward.
Like arrows in the hand of a warrior are the children of one's youth.
Happy is the man who has filled his quiver with them! They will not be put to shame when they speak with enemies at the gate.
A song of ascents. Happy is everyone who fears the LORD, who walks in his ways.
You will eat the fruit of your labor; you will be happy, and it will go well with you.
Your wife will be like a fruitful vine within your house, your children like olive shoots around your table.
Look, this is how the man who fears the LORD will be blessed.
May the LORD bless you from Zion; may you see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
May you see your children's children. Peace be on Israel!
A song of ascents. "Often they have attacked me from my youth," let Israel now say,
"often they have attacked me from my youth, yet they have not overcome me.
The plowers plowed over my back; they made their furrows long."
The LORD is righteous; he has cut the cords of the wicked.
May all who hate Zion be put to shame and turned back.
May they be like grass on the rooftops, which withers before it grows up,
with which the reaper does not fill his hand, nor the binder of sheaves his arms,
and those who pass by do not say, "The blessing of the LORD be on you! We bless you in the name of the LORD."
A song of ascents. Out of the depths I call to you, LORD.
Lord, hear my voice! Let your ears be attentive to my voice as I plead for mercy.
If you, LORD, kept a record of iniquities, Lord, who could stand?
But with you there is forgiveness, so that you may be feared.
I wait for the LORD; my soul waits, and in his word I put my hope.
My soul waits for the Lord more than watchmen wait for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.
Israel, put your hope in the LORD! For with the LORD there is faithful love, and with him is abundant redemption.
He himself will redeem Israel from all its iniquities.
A song of ascents. Of David. LORD, my heart is not proud, and my eyes are not haughty. I do not concern myself with great matters, or with things too wonderful for me.
Instead, I have calmed and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with its mother; my soul within me is like a weaned child.
Israel, put your hope in the LORD, from now on and forever.
A song of ascents. LORD, remember David and all his hardships,
how he swore an oath to the LORD and made a vow to the Mighty One of Jacob:
"I will not enter the tent of my house or get into my bed;
I will not give sleep to my eyes or slumber to my eyelids,
until I find a place for the LORD, a dwelling place for the Mighty One of Jacob."
Look, we heard of it in Ephrathah; we found it in the fields of Jaar.
Let us go to his dwelling place; let us bow down at his footstool.
Rise up, LORD, and go to your resting place, you and the ark of your might.
May your priests be clothed with righteousness, and may your faithful ones shout for joy.
For the sake of David your servant, do not reject your anointed one.
The LORD swore to David a sure oath, from which he will not turn back: "One of your own descendants I will set on your throne.
If your sons keep my covenant and my statutes that I will teach them, their sons also will sit on your throne forever."
For the LORD has chosen Zion; he has desired it for his dwelling:
"This is my resting place forever; here I will dwell, for I have desired it.
I will richly bless its provisions; I will satisfy its needy with bread.
Its priests I will clothe with salvation, and its faithful ones will shout aloud for joy.
There I will make a horn sprout for David; I have prepared a lamp for my anointed one.
His enemies I will clothe with shame, but on him his crown will shine."
A song of ascents. Of David. Look, how good and how pleasant it is when brothers live together in unity!
It is like the fine oil on the head, running down on the beard, the beard of Aaron, running down over the collar of his robes.
It is like the dew of Hermon, which falls on the mountains of Zion. For there the LORD has commanded the blessing: life forevermore.
A song of ascents. Come, bless the LORD, all you servants of the LORD, who stand in the house of the LORD by night.
Lift up your hands toward the sanctuary, and bless the LORD.
May the LORD bless you from Zion, the maker of heaven and earth.
Praise the LORD! Praise the name of the LORD; praise him, you servants of the LORD,
who stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God.
Praise the LORD, for the LORD is good; sing praises to his name, for it is pleasant.
For the LORD has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel as his treasured possession.
For I know that the LORD is great, and our Lord is above all gods.
Whatever the LORD pleases, he does, in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and all the depths.
He makes the clouds rise from the ends of the earth; he makes lightning for the rain, and brings out the wind from his storehouses.
He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, both human and animal.
He sent signs and wonders into your midst, Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants.
He struck down many nations and killed mighty kings:
Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan.
He gave their land as an inheritance, an inheritance to his people Israel.
LORD, your name endures forever, your renown, LORD, from generation to generation.
For the LORD will give justice to his people and have compassion on his servants.
The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of human hands.
They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see.
They have ears, but cannot hear, and there is no breath in their mouths.
Those who make them will become like them, and so will all who trust in them.
House of Israel, bless the LORD! House of Aaron, bless the LORD!
House of Levi, bless the LORD! You who fear the LORD, bless the LORD!
Blessed be the LORD from Zion, he who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his faithful love endures forever.
Give thanks to the God of gods, for his faithful love endures forever.
Give thanks to the Lord of lords, for his faithful love endures forever;
to him who alone does great wonders, for his faithful love endures forever;
who by understanding made the heavens, for his faithful love endures forever;
who spread out the earth on the waters, for his faithful love endures forever;
who made the great lights, for his faithful love endures forever;
the sun to rule by day, for his faithful love endures forever;
the moon and the stars to rule by night, for his faithful love endures forever;
who struck down Egypt through their firstborn, for his faithful love endures forever;
and brought Israel out from among them, for his faithful love endures forever;
with a strong hand and an outstretched arm, for his faithful love endures forever;
who divided the Red Sea in two, for his faithful love endures forever;
and made Israel pass through the middle of it, for his faithful love endures forever;
but swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea, for his faithful love endures forever;
who led his people through the wilderness, for his faithful love endures forever;
who struck down great kings, for his faithful love endures forever;
and killed mighty kings, for his faithful love endures forever;
Sihon king of the Amorites, for his faithful love endures forever;
and Og king of Bashan, for his faithful love endures forever;
and gave their land as an inheritance, for his faithful love endures forever;
an inheritance to Israel his servant, for his faithful love endures forever;
who remembered us in our low condition, for his faithful love endures forever;
and rescued us from our adversaries, for his faithful love endures forever;
who gives food to every living creature, for his faithful love endures forever.
Give thanks to the God of heaven, for his faithful love endures forever.
By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down and wept when we remembered Zion.
On the poplars there we hung up our lyres.
For there our captors asked us for songs, and our tormentors asked for joy: "Sing us one of the songs of Zion!"
How can we sing the song of the LORD in a foreign land?
If I forget you, Jerusalem, may my right hand forget its skill.
May my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I do not remember you, if I do not set Jerusalem above my highest joy.
Remember, LORD, against the Edomites the day of Jerusalem, when they said, "Tear it down! Tear it down to its foundations!"
Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, happy is the one who pays you back for what you have done to us.
Happy is the one who seizes your little ones and dashes them against the rock!
Of David. I will give thanks to you with all my heart; before the gods I will sing your praise.
I will bow down toward your holy temple and give thanks to your name for your faithful love and your faithfulness, for you have made your promise greater than all your name.
On the day I called, you answered me; you made me bold, with strength in my soul.
All the kings of the earth will give thanks to you, LORD, when they hear the words of your mouth.
They will sing of the ways of the LORD, for great is the glory of the LORD.
For though the LORD is high, he looks on the lowly; but the proud he knows from far away.
Though I walk in the midst of trouble, you preserve my life; you stretch out your hand against the anger of my enemies, and your right hand saves me.
The LORD will fulfill his purpose for me. LORD, your faithful love endures forever; do not abandon the works of your hands.
For the director. Of David. A psalm. LORD, you have searched me and you know me.
You know when I sit down and when I rise up; you understand my thoughts from far away.
You sift my path and my lying down; you are familiar with all my ways.
Even before a word is on my tongue, look, LORD, you know it completely.
You hem me in behind and before; you have laid your hand on me.
Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is too high, I cannot reach it.
Where can I go from your Spirit? Where can I flee from your presence?
If I go up to the heavens, you are there; if I make my bed in Sheol, you are there too.
If I take the wings of the dawn and settle at the far side of the sea,
even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me fast.
If I say, "Surely the darkness will overwhelm me, and the light around me will become night,"
even the darkness is not dark to you; the night shines like the day, for darkness is as light to you.
For you created my inmost being; you wove me together in my mother's womb.
I praise you, for I am awesomely and wonderfully made. Wonderful are your works; my soul knows it very well.
My frame was not hidden from you when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.
Your eyes saw my unformed body; in your book they were all written, the days that were shaped for me, each one of them.
How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is the sum of them!
If I counted them, they would outnumber the grains of sand. I awake, and I am still with you.
If only you would kill the wicked, God! You bloodthirsty people, go away from me!
They speak of you with evil intent; your enemies take your name in vain.
Do I not hate those who hate you, LORD? Do I not loathe those who rise up against you?
I hate them with complete hatred; they have become my enemies.
Search me, God, and know my heart; test me and know my anxious thoughts.
See if there is any hurtful way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
For the director. A psalm of David.
Rescue me, LORD, from evil people; guard me from the violent,
who plan evil things in their hearts and stir up wars every day.
They sharpen their tongues like a serpent's; the venom of vipers is under their lips. Selah.
Keep me, LORD, from the hands of the wicked; guard me from the violent, who plan to trip up my feet.
The arrogant have hidden a trap for me, and cords; they have spread a net beside the path; they have set snares for me. Selah.
I say to the LORD, "You are my God." Listen, LORD, to my voice as I plead for mercy.
GOD the Lord, my strong salvation, you shield my head on the day of battle.
Do not grant, LORD, the desires of the wicked; do not let their schemes succeed, or they will be exalted. Selah.
As for the heads of those who surround me, may the trouble their own lips cause cover them.
May burning coals fall on them; may they be thrown into the fire, into deep pits, never to rise again.
Do not let a slanderer be established in the land; may evil hunt down the violent with blow upon blow.
I know that the LORD upholds the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.
Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name; the upright will live in your presence.
A psalm of David. LORD, I call to you; come quickly to me. Listen to my voice when I call to you.
May my prayer be set before you like incense, the lifting up of my hands like the evening offering.
Set a guard, LORD, over my mouth; keep watch over the door of my lips.
Do not let my heart turn to anything evil, to do wicked deeds with those who are evildoers; do not let me eat of their delicacies.
Let a righteous person strike me: it is faithful love; let him rebuke me: it is oil for my head; let my head not refuse it. For my prayer is still against their evil deeds.
When their rulers are thrown down from the sides of the cliff, they will hear my words, for they are pleasant.
As when one plows and breaks up the ground, our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.
But my eyes are on you, GOD the Lord; in you I take refuge; do not pour out my life.
Keep me from the trap they have laid for me, and from the snares of the evildoers.
Let the wicked fall into their own nets, while I pass by safely.
A maskil of David, when he was in the cave. A prayer.
With my voice I cry out to the LORD; with my voice I plead with the LORD for mercy.
I pour out my complaint before him; I tell him of my trouble.
When my spirit grows faint within me, you know my way. In the path where I walk they have hidden a trap for me.
Look to my right and see: there is no one who takes notice of me. I have no refuge; no one cares for my life.
I cry out to you, LORD; I say, "You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living."
Listen to my cry, for I am brought very low. Rescue me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.
Bring me out of prison, so that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will gather around me, for you will deal generously with me.
A psalm of David. LORD, hear my prayer; listen to my pleas for mercy. In your faithfulness answer me, in your righteousness.
Do not bring your servant into judgment, for no one living is righteous before you.
For the enemy has pursued my soul; he has crushed my life to the ground; he has made me sit in darkness like those long dead.
So my spirit grows faint within me; my heart within me is appalled.
I remember the days of old; I meditate on all your deeds; I reflect on the work of your hands.
I spread out my hands to you; my soul thirsts for you like a parched land. Selah.
Answer me quickly, LORD; my spirit fails. Do not hide your face from me, or I will be like those who go down to the pit.
Let me hear of your faithful love in the morning, for in you I trust. Make me know the way I should go, for to you I lift up my soul.
Rescue me from my enemies, LORD; I hide myself in you.
Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. May your good Spirit lead me on level ground.
For the sake of your name, LORD, give me life; in your righteousness bring me out of trouble.
In your faithful love, destroy my enemies, and wipe out all my adversaries, for I am your servant.
Of David. Blessed be the LORD, my rock, who trains my hands for war, my fingers for battle,
my faithful love and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer, my shield, in whom I take refuge, who subdues my people under me.
LORD, what is a human being, that you take notice of him, a son of man, that you think of him?
A human being is like a breath; his days are like a passing shadow.
LORD, bend your heavens and come down; touch the mountains, so that they smoke.
Flash out lightning and scatter them; send out your arrows and throw them into confusion.
Stretch out your hands from on high; set me free and rescue me from the mighty waters, from the hand of foreigners,
whose mouths speak lies, and whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
God, I will sing a new song to you; on a ten-stringed harp I will make music to you,
the one who gives victory to kings, who sets David his servant free from the cruel sword.
Set me free and rescue me from the hand of foreigners, whose mouths speak lies, and whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
May our sons in their youth be like plants grown tall, our daughters like corner pillars carved for a palace.
May our barns be full, supplying every kind of produce; may our flocks increase by thousands, by tens of thousands in our fields.
May our cattle be heavy with young; may there be no breach in the walls, no going into exile, and no cry of distress in our streets.
Happy are the people for whom it is so; happy are the people whose God is the LORD!
A song of praise. Of David. I will exalt you, my God the King, and bless your name forever and ever.
Every day I will bless you and praise your name forever and ever.
Great is the LORD, and most worthy of praise; his greatness is beyond searching out.
One generation will commend your works to another; they will tell of your mighty acts.
On the glorious splendor of your majesty and on your wonderful works I will meditate.
They will speak of the power of your awesome deeds, and I will tell of your greatness.
They will pour out the memory of your abundant goodness and sing joyfully of your righteousness.
The LORD is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and great in faithful love.
The LORD is good to all, and his compassion is over all that he has made.
All your works will give thanks to you, LORD, and your faithful ones will bless you.
They will speak of the glory of your kingdom and talk of your might,
to make known to human beings his mighty acts, and the glorious splendor of his kingdom.
Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and your dominion endures through all generations.
The LORD upholds all who fall, and raises up all who are bowed down.
The eyes of all look to you, and you give them their food at the proper time.
You open your hand and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
The LORD is righteous in all his ways and faithful in all his deeds.
The LORD is near to all who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
He fulfills the desire of those who fear him; he hears their cry and saves them.
The LORD watches over all who love him, but all the wicked he will destroy.
My mouth will speak the praise of the LORD, and let every creature bless his holy name forever and ever.
Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD, my soul!
I will praise the LORD as long as I live; I will sing praises to my God while I have being.
Do not put your trust in nobles, in a mortal, who cannot save.
When his breath departs, he returns to his ground; on that very day his plans perish.
Happy is the one whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the LORD his God,
the maker of heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them, who keeps faith forever,
who brings about justice for the oppressed, who gives food to the hungry. The LORD sets the prisoners free;
the LORD opens the eyes of the blind; the LORD raises up those who are bowed down; the LORD loves the righteous.
The LORD watches over the foreigners; he upholds the orphan and the widow, but he twists the way of the wicked.
The LORD will reign forever, your God, Zion, from generation to generation. Praise the LORD!
Praise the LORD! For it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant, and praise is fitting.
The LORD builds up Jerusalem; he gathers the outcasts of Israel.
He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
He counts the number of the stars; he gives names to all of them.
Great is our Lord, and abundant in power; his understanding is beyond measure.
The LORD lifts up the humble; he casts the wicked down to the ground.
Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving; make music to our God on the lyre.
He covers the heavens with clouds; he prepares rain for the earth; he makes grass grow on the mountains.
He gives the animals their food, and the young ravens when they call.
He takes no delight in the strength of the horse, no pleasure in the legs of a warrior.
The LORD takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his faithful love.
Extol the LORD, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!
For he has strengthened the bars of your gates; he has blessed your children within you.
He grants peace within your borders; he satisfies you with the finest wheat.
He sends out his command to the earth; his word runs swiftly.
He gives snow like wool; he scatters frost like ashes.
He hurls down his hail like crumbs. Who can stand before his cold?
He sends out his word and melts them; he makes his wind blow, and the waters flow.
He declares his words to Jacob, his decrees and his rulings to Israel.
He has not done this for any other nation; they do not know his rulings. Praise the LORD!
Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD from the heavens; praise him in the heights!
Praise him, all his angels; praise him, all his armies!
Praise him, sun and moon; praise him, all you shining stars!
Praise him, you highest heavens, and you waters above the heavens!
Let them praise the name of the LORD, for he commanded, and they were created.
He established them forever and ever; he gave a decree that will not pass away.
Praise the LORD from the earth, you sea monsters and all the depths,
fire and hail, snow and mist, stormy wind that carries out his word,
mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,
wild animals and all livestock, creatures that move along the ground and winged birds,
kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all who rule the earth,
young men and young women alike, old and young together.
Let them praise the name of the LORD, for his name alone is exalted; his splendor is above the earth and the heavens.
He has raised up a horn for his people, praise for all his faithful ones, for the Israelites, the people close to him. Praise the LORD!
Praise the LORD! Sing to the LORD a new song, his praise in the assembly of the faithful.
Let Israel rejoice in their Maker; let the people of Zion be glad in their King.
Let them praise his name with dancing; let them make music to him with tambourine and lyre.
For the LORD takes pleasure in his people; he crowns the humble with salvation.
Let the faithful exult in glory; let them sing for joy on their beds.
Let the high praises of God be in their throats, and a two-edged sword in their hands,
to carry out vengeance on the nations, punishment on the peoples,
to bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron,
to carry out on them the judgment written. This is the honor of all his faithful ones. Praise the LORD!
Praise the LORD! Praise God in his sanctuary; praise him in the mighty dome of the sky!
Praise him for his mighty deeds; praise him for his surpassing greatness!
Praise him with the blast of the ram's horn; praise him with harp and lyre!
Praise him with tambourine and dancing; praise him with strings and pipe!
Praise him with clashing cymbals; praise him with resounding cymbals!
Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Praise the LORD!
The proverbs of Solomon son of David, king of Israel,
for learning wisdom and discipline, for grasping words of understanding,
for receiving discipline in wise conduct, in righteousness, justice and fairness,
for giving prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young.
Let the wise listen and add to their learning; let the discerning gain guidance,
for understanding a proverb and a figure of speech, the words of the wise and their riddles.
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge; fools despise wisdom and discipline.
Listen, my son, to your father's discipline, and do not abandon your mother's instruction.
For they are a graceful garland for your head and a necklace for your neck.
My son, if sinners entice you, do not give in.
If they say, "Come with us; let us lie in wait to shed blood; let us ambush the innocent for no reason;
let us swallow them alive like Sheol, whole, like those who go down to the Pit;
we will find all kinds of precious wealth; we will fill our houses with plunder.
Throw in your lot with us; we will all have one purse,"
my son, do not walk on the road with them; keep your foot from their path.
For their feet run to evil, and they hurry to shed blood.
For it is useless to spread a net in the sight of any bird.
But these men lie in wait for their own blood; they ambush their own lives.
Such are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain: it takes away the life of those who possess it.
Wisdom cries aloud in the street; in the squares she raises her voice.
At the head of the bustling streets she calls out; at the entrances of the city gates she speaks her words:
"How long, you simple ones, will you love being simple? How long will mockers delight in their mocking, and fools hate knowledge?
Turn back at my correction! Look, I will pour out my spirit to you; I will make my words known to you.
Because I called and you refused, because I stretched out my hand and no one paid attention,
because you ignored all my advice and would have none of my correction,
I in turn will laugh at your disaster; I will mock when what you dread comes,
when what you dread comes like a storm, and your disaster sweeps in like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come upon you.
Then they will call to me, but I will not answer; they will search hard for me, but they will not find me.
Because they hated knowledge and did not choose the fear of the LORD,
because they would have none of my advice and spurned all my correction,
they will eat the fruit of their own way and be stuffed full of their own schemes.
For the waywardness of the simple will kill them, and the complacency of fools will destroy them.
But whoever listens to me will live in safety and be at ease, with no dread of harm."
My son, if you accept my words and store up my commands within you,
turning your ear to wisdom and inclining your heart to insight,
if you call out for understanding and raise your voice for insight,
if you look for it as for silver and search for it as for hidden treasure,
then you will understand the fear of the LORD and find the knowledge of God.
For the LORD gives wisdom; from his mouth come knowledge and insight.
He stores up sound wisdom for the upright; he is a shield to those who walk in integrity,
guarding the paths of justice and watching over the way of his faithful ones.
Then you will understand righteousness and justice and fairness, every good path.
For wisdom will come into your heart, and knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.
Discretion will watch over you; insight will guard you,
to rescue you from the way of evil, from men who speak perversely,
who abandon the paths of uprightness to walk in the ways of darkness,
who delight in doing evil and rejoice in the perversity of evil,
whose paths are crooked and whose ways are devious;
to rescue you from the strange woman, from the foreign woman with her smooth words,
who abandons the companion of her youth and forgets the covenant of her God.
For her house sinks down to death, and her paths lead to the dead.
None who go to her come back, and they do not reach the paths of life.
So you will walk in the way of good people and keep to the paths of the righteous.
For the upright will live in the land, and the blameless will remain in it,
but the wicked will be cut off from the land, and the treacherous will be torn out of it.
My son, do not forget my instruction, and let your heart keep my commands,
for they will add to your life many days and years, and peace.
Do not let faithful love and truth leave you. Tie them around your neck; write them on the tablet of your heart.
Then you will find favor and a good name in the sight of God and of people.
Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and do not rely on your own understanding.
In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
Do not be wise in your own eyes; fear the LORD and turn away from evil.
It will be healing for your body and refreshment for your bones.
Honor the LORD with your wealth and with the firstfruits of all your harvest.
Then your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.
My son, do not reject the discipline of the LORD, and do not resent his correction,
for the LORD corrects the one he loves, as a father corrects the son he delights in.
Happy is the one who finds wisdom, the one who gains insight.
For she is more profitable than silver, and her yield is better than fine gold.
She is more precious than coral; nothing you desire can compare with her.
Long life is in her right hand; in her left hand are riches and honor.
Her ways are pleasant ways, and all her paths are peace.
She is a tree of life to those who take hold of her; those who hold on to her are happy.
By wisdom the LORD founded the earth; by insight he established the heavens.
By his knowledge the deep waters burst open, and the clouds drop down dew.
My son, do not let them out of your sight: keep sound wisdom and discretion,
and they will be life for your soul and a lovely ornament for your neck.
Then you will walk on your way in safety, and your foot will not stumble.
When you lie down, you will not be afraid; when you lie down, your sleep will be sweet.
Do not be afraid of sudden terror, or of the ruin of the wicked when it comes.
For the LORD will be your confidence and will keep your foot from being caught.
Do not withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in your power to do it.
Do not say to your neighbor, "Go away and come back; I will give it to you tomorrow," when you have it with you.
Do not plot harm against your neighbor while he lives trustingly beside you.
Do not quarrel with anyone for no reason, when he has done you no harm.
Do not envy a violent man, and do not choose any of his ways.
For the devious are detestable to the LORD, but he takes the upright into his confidence.
The LORD's curse is on the house of the wicked, but he blesses the home of the righteous.
He mocks the mockers, but he gives favor to the humble.
The wise will inherit honor, but fools carry off disgrace.
Listen, sons, to a father's discipline, and pay attention so that you may know understanding.
For I am giving you good teaching; do not abandon my instruction.
When I was a son to my father, tender, the only child in my mother's eyes,
he taught me and said to me, "Let your heart hold on to my words; keep my commands, and live.
Get wisdom, get understanding; do not forget the words of my mouth, and do not turn away from them.
Do not abandon her, and she will guard you; love her, and she will watch over you.
The beginning of wisdom is this: get wisdom. Whatever else you get, get understanding.
Prize her, and she will lift you up; she will bring you honor if you embrace her.
She will place a graceful garland on your head; she will present you with a beautiful crown."
Listen, my son, and accept my words, and the years of your life will be many.
I have taught you in the way of wisdom; I have led you along straight paths.
When you walk, your steps will not be hampered, and if you run, you will not stumble.
Hold on to discipline; do not let it go. Guard her, for she is your life.
Do not set foot on the path of the wicked, and do not walk in the way of evildoers.
Avoid it; do not travel on it. Turn away from it and pass on.
For they cannot sleep unless they have done wrong; they are robbed of sleep unless they have made someone stumble.
For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.
But the path of the righteous is like the light of dawn, shining brighter and brighter until full day.
The way of the wicked is like deep darkness; they do not know what makes them stumble.
My son, pay attention to my words; turn your ear to my sayings.
Do not let them slip from your sight; keep them deep within your heart.
For they are life to those who find them, and healing for their whole body.
Above all else that you guard, guard your heart, for from it flow the springs of life.
Put away from you a crooked mouth, and keep devious lips far from you.
Let your eyes look straight ahead, and your gaze be fixed straight in front of you.
Make level the path for your feet, and all your ways will be secure.
Do not turn to the right or to the left; keep your foot away from evil.
My son, pay attention to my wisdom; turn your ear to my insight,
so that you may keep discretion, and your lips may guard knowledge.
For the lips of the strange woman drip honey, and her speech is smoother than oil.
But in the end she is as bitter as wormwood, as sharp as a two-edged sword.
Her feet go down to death; her steps lead straight to Sheol.
She gives no thought to the path of life; her tracks wander, and she does not know it.
So now, sons, listen to me, and do not turn away from the words of my mouth.
Keep your way far from her, and do not go near the door of her house,
or you will give your vigor to others and your years to someone cruel,
or strangers will feast on your strength, and what you have toiled for will go to the house of a foreigner.
At the end of your life you will groan, when your flesh and your body are worn out,
and you will say, "How I hated discipline! How my heart spurned correction!
I did not listen to the voice of my teachers or turn my ear to my instructors.
I have almost come to utter ruin in the middle of the assembly and the community."
Drink water from your own cistern, flowing water from your own well.
Should your springs overflow into the street, streams of water in the public squares?
Let them be yours alone, not shared with strangers.
Let your fountain be blessed, and rejoice in the wife of your youth,
a loving doe, a graceful deer. Let her breasts satisfy you at all times; be intoxicated always with her love.
Why should you be intoxicated, my son, with a strange woman, and embrace the breast of a foreign woman?
For a person's ways are in full view of the LORD's eyes, and he examines all their paths.
The wicked man's own iniquities will capture him, and he will be held fast by the cords of his sin.
He will die for lack of discipline, and in his great folly he will go astray.
My son, if you have put up security for your neighbor, if you have shaken hands on a pledge for a stranger,
if you have been trapped by the words of your mouth, caught by the words of your mouth,
then do this, my son, and free yourself, since you have fallen into your neighbor's power: go, humble yourself, and press your neighbor hard.
Give no sleep to your eyes and no slumber to your eyelids.
Free yourself like a gazelle from the hunter's hand, like a bird from the hand of the fowler.
Go to the ant, you lazy person; watch her ways and be wise.
She has no commander, no overseer or ruler,
yet she prepares her food in summer and gathers her provisions at harvest.
How long will you lie there, you lazy person? When will you get up from your sleep?
A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to rest,
and poverty will come on you like a prowler, and need like an armed man.
A worthless person, a wicked man, goes about with a crooked mouth,
winking with his eyes, signaling with his feet, pointing with his fingers,
with perversity in his heart, always plotting evil, stirring up quarrels.
So disaster will come on him suddenly; in an instant he will be broken, and there will be no healing.
There are six things that the LORD hates, seven that are detestable to him:
haughty eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,
a heart that devises wicked plans, feet that hurry to run to evil,
a false witness who breathes out lies, and one who stirs up quarrels among brothers.
My son, keep your father's command, and do not abandon your mother's instruction.
Bind them on your heart always; tie them around your neck.
When you walk, they will guide you; when you lie down, they will watch over you; and when you wake up, they will talk with you.
For the command is a lamp, and the instruction is a light, and the corrections of discipline are the way of life,
to keep you from the evil woman, from the smooth tongue of the foreign woman.
Do not desire her beauty in your heart, and do not let her captivate you with her eyelashes.
For a prostitute costs only a loaf of bread, but another man's wife hunts down a precious life.
Can a man scoop fire into his lap without his clothes being burned?
Can a man walk on hot coals without his feet being scorched?
So it is with the one who goes in to his neighbor's wife: no one who touches her will go unpunished.
People do not despise a thief if he steals to satisfy his hunger when he is starving.
Yet if he is caught, he must pay back sevenfold; he must give up all the wealth of his house.
The man who commits adultery with a woman lacks sense; whoever does it destroys himself.
He will get blows and disgrace, and his shame will never be wiped away.
For jealousy arouses a husband's fury, and he will show no mercy on the day of revenge.
He will not accept any compensation; he will refuse it, however great the bribe.
My son, keep my words and store up my commands within you.
Keep my commands and live; guard my instruction like the pupil of your eye.
Tie them on your fingers; write them on the tablet of your heart.
Say to wisdom, "You are my sister," and call understanding your close relative,
so that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the foreign woman with her smooth words.
For at the window of my house I looked down through my lattice,
and I saw among the simple, I noticed among the young men, a youth who lacked sense.
He was passing along the street near her corner, stepping out on the road to her house,
in the twilight, in the evening of the day, in the black of night and the darkness.
And look, a woman came to meet him, dressed like a prostitute, with a guarded heart.
She is loud and defiant; her feet do not stay at home.
Now in the street, now in the squares, she lies in wait at every corner.
She took hold of him and kissed him, and with a brazen face she said to him,
"I had fellowship offerings to make; today I have fulfilled my vows.
That is why I came out to meet you, to look for you, and I have found you.
I have spread my couch with coverings, with colored linen from Egypt.
I have sprinkled my bed with myrrh, aloes and cinnamon.
Come, let us drink our fill of love until morning; let us delight ourselves with lovemaking.
For my husband is not at home; he has gone on a long journey.
He took a bag of money with him; he will not come home until the full moon."
With all her persuasion she led him astray; with her smooth lips she seduced him.
All at once he followed her, like an ox going to the slaughter, like a fool in fetters going to be punished,
until an arrow pierces his liver, like a bird rushing into a trap, not knowing that it will cost him his life.
So now, sons, listen to me, and pay attention to the words of my mouth.
Do not let your heart turn aside to her ways; do not stray onto her paths.
For many are the victims she has brought down, and all those she has killed are a mighty throng.
Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the chambers of death.
Does not wisdom call out? Does not insight raise her voice?
On the heights beside the road, where the paths meet, she takes her stand;
beside the gates at the entrance to the city, at the doorways, she cries aloud:
"To you, people, I call; my voice goes out to all humankind.
You simple ones, learn prudence; you fools, learn good sense.
Listen, for I speak of noble things, and what opens my lips is what is right.
For my mouth speaks truth, and wickedness is detestable to my lips.
All the words of my mouth are righteous; there is nothing twisted or crooked in them.
They are all plain to the one who understands, and right to those who find knowledge.
Take my discipline instead of silver, and knowledge rather than choice gold.
For wisdom is better than coral, and nothing you desire can compare with her.
I, wisdom, live with prudence, and I possess knowledge and discretion.
The fear of the LORD is hating evil. Pride and arrogance, the way of evil and a perverse mouth, I hate.
Advice and sound wisdom are mine; I am understanding; strength is mine.
By me kings reign, and rulers decree what is just.
By me princes rule, and nobles, all who judge rightly.
I love those who love me, and those who search hard for me find me.
Riches and honor are with me, lasting wealth and righteousness.
My fruit is better than gold, even fine gold, and my yield is better than choice silver.
I walk in the way of righteousness, along the paths of justice,
to give wealth as an inheritance to those who love me, and to fill their treasuries.
The LORD created me at the beginning of his way, before his works of long ago.
Long ages ago I was installed, at the very first, before the earth began.
When there were no deep waters I was brought forth, when there were no springs heavy with water.
Before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was brought forth,
before he had made the earth and the open fields, or the first of the dust of the world.
When he established the heavens, I was there, when he marked out a circle on the face of the deep,
when he made firm the clouds above, when the springs of the deep grew strong,
when he set for the sea its limit, so that the waters would not overstep his command, when he marked out the foundations of the earth,
then I was beside him as a master craftsman. I was his delight day after day, playing before him at all times,
playing in his inhabited world, and delighting in humankind.
So now, sons, listen to me: happy are those who keep my ways.
Listen to discipline and be wise; do not ignore it.
Happy is the person who listens to me, watching daily at my doors, waiting beside my doorposts.
For whoever finds me finds life and obtains favor from the LORD.
But whoever misses me harms himself; all who hate me love death."
Wisdom has built her house; she has carved out her seven pillars.
She has slaughtered her meat, mixed her wine, and set her table.
She has sent out her young women; she calls from the highest points of the city,
"Whoever is simple, turn in here!" To the one who lacks sense she says,
"Come, eat my bread and drink the wine I have mixed.
Leave simple ways and live, and walk in the way of understanding."
Whoever disciplines a mocker invites insult; whoever corrects a wicked person gets hurt.
Do not correct a mocker, or he will hate you; correct a wise person, and he will love you.
Instruct a wise person, and he will become wiser still; teach a righteous person, and he will add to his learning.
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom, and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
For through me your days will be many, and years will be added to your life.
If you are wise, you are wise for your own good; if you mock, you alone will bear it.
The woman Folly is loud; she is simple and knows nothing at all.
She sits at the door of her house, on a seat at the highest point of the city,
calling to those who pass by, who are going straight along their way,
"Whoever is simple, turn in here!" And to the one who lacks sense she says,
"Stolen water is sweet, and bread eaten in secret is delicious."
But he does not know that the dead are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a father glad, but a foolish son is his mother's grief.
Treasures gained by wickedness are of no use, but righteousness rescues from death.
The LORD will not let the righteous go hungry, but he thrusts away the craving of the wicked.
A slack hand makes a person poor, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.
A son who gathers in summer is sensible; a son who sleeps at harvest brings shame.
Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.
The memory of the righteous is a blessing, but the name of the wicked will rot.
The wise in heart accept commands, but a chattering fool will be ruined.
Whoever walks in integrity walks securely, but whoever makes his ways crooked will be found out.
Whoever winks with the eye causes trouble, and a chattering fool will be ruined.
The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.
Hatred stirs up quarrels, but love covers all offenses.
Wisdom is found on the lips of the discerning, but a rod is for the back of one who lacks sense.
The wise store up knowledge, but the mouth of a fool brings ruin near.
The wealth of the rich is their strong city; the ruin of the poor is their poverty.
The wages of the righteous lead to life; the income of the wicked leads to sin.
Whoever heeds discipline is on the path to life, but whoever rejects correction leads others astray.
Whoever hides hatred has lying lips, and whoever spreads slander is a fool.
When words are many, wrongdoing is not lacking, but whoever restrains his lips is sensible.
The tongue of the righteous is choice silver; the heart of the wicked is worth little.
The lips of the righteous feed many, but fools die for lack of sense.
The blessing of the LORD makes rich, and he adds no sorrow to it.
To a fool, doing wrong is like play, and so is wisdom to a person of insight.
What the wicked dreads will come upon him, but what the righteous desire will be granted.
When the storm has passed, the wicked are gone, but the righteous are a lasting foundation.
Like vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes, so is the lazy person to those who send him.
The fear of the LORD adds days, but the years of the wicked will be cut short.
The hope of the righteous ends in joy, but the expectation of the wicked will perish.
The way of the LORD is a stronghold for the blameless, but ruin for those who do evil.
The righteous will never be shaken, but the wicked will not remain in the land.
The mouth of the righteous yields wisdom, but a perverse tongue will be cut off.
The lips of the righteous know what is pleasing, but the mouth of the wicked knows what is perverse.
Dishonest scales are detestable to the LORD, but an accurate weight is his delight.
When pride comes, disgrace comes too, but with the humble is wisdom.
The integrity of the upright guides them, but the crookedness of the treacherous destroys them.
Wealth is of no use on the day of wrath, but righteousness rescues from death.
The righteousness of the blameless makes their way straight, but the wicked fall by their own wickedness.
The righteousness of the upright rescues them, but the treacherous are caught by their own craving.
When a wicked person dies, his hope perishes, and the expectation placed in wealth perishes too.
The righteous person is rescued from trouble, and the wicked comes in his place.
With his mouth the godless destroys his neighbor, but by knowledge the righteous are rescued.
When the righteous prosper, the city rejoices, and when the wicked perish, there are shouts of joy.
By the blessing of the upright a city is raised up, but by the mouth of the wicked it is torn down.
Whoever belittles his neighbor lacks sense, but a person of insight keeps silent.
A gossip goes around revealing secrets, but one who is trustworthy in spirit keeps a matter hidden.
Without guidance a people falls, but with many advisers there is victory.
Whoever puts up security for a stranger will surely suffer for it, but whoever hates shaking hands on a pledge is safe.
A gracious woman takes hold of honor, and ruthless men take hold of wealth.
A kind man benefits himself, but a cruel man brings trouble on his own body.
The wicked earns deceptive wages, but whoever sows righteousness reaps a true reward.
Truly righteousness leads to life, but whoever pursues evil goes to his death.
People with crooked hearts are detestable to the LORD, but those whose way is blameless are his delight.
You can be sure the evil person will not go unpunished, but the descendants of the righteous will escape.
Like a gold ring in a pig's snout is a beautiful woman who lacks good judgment.
The desire of the righteous ends only in good; the hope of the wicked, in wrath.
One person gives freely and yet grows richer; another holds back more than is right and only comes to need.
A generous person will grow fat, and whoever gives water will himself be watered.
People curse whoever holds back grain, but blessing is on the head of the one who sells it.
Whoever eagerly seeks good is seeking favor, but evil comes to the one who looks for it.
Whoever trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous will flourish like a green leaf.
Whoever brings trouble on his household will inherit the wind, and the fool will be servant to the wise of heart.
The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life, and whoever wins people over is wise.
If the righteous are repaid on earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner!
Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge, but whoever hates correction is stupid.
A good person obtains favor from the LORD, but he condemns a man who schemes.
No one is made secure by wickedness, but the root of the righteous will never be moved.
A capable wife is her husband's crown, but a wife who brings shame is like rot in his bones.
The plans of the righteous are just; the guidance of the wicked is deceit.
The words of the wicked are an ambush for blood, but the mouth of the upright rescues them.
The wicked are overthrown and are no more, but the house of the righteous will stand.
A man is praised according to his good sense, but one with a twisted heart will be despised.
Better to be lowly and have a servant than to act important and have no bread.
The righteous person cares about the life of his animal, but even the compassion of the wicked is cruel.
Whoever works his land will have plenty of bread, but whoever chases worthless things lacks sense.
The wicked covet the catch of evildoers, but the root of the righteous yields fruit.
By the sin of his lips an evil person is trapped, but the righteous escapes from trouble.
From the fruit of his mouth a person is filled with good, and the deeds of a person's hands are repaid to him.
The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but whoever listens to advice is wise.
A fool shows his anger at once, but the prudent overlooks an insult.
Whoever speaks the truth tells what is right, but a false witness tells deceit.
Some people's rash words are like sword thrusts, but the tongue of the wise brings healing.
Truthful lips will endure forever, but a lying tongue lasts only a moment.
Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but those who counsel peace have joy.
No harm will happen to the righteous, but the wicked are filled with trouble.
Lying lips are detestable to the LORD, but those who act faithfully are his delight.
A prudent person conceals knowledge, but the heart of fools proclaims folly.
The hand of the diligent will rule, but the slack hand will be put to forced labor.
Anxiety in a person's heart weighs it down, but a good word makes it glad.
The righteous person guides his neighbor, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.
The lazy man does not roast his game, but diligence is a person's precious wealth.
In the path of righteousness is life, and in its way there is no death.
A wise son heeds his father's discipline, but a mocker does not listen to rebuke.
From the fruit of his mouth a person eats what is good, but the treacherous crave violence.
Whoever guards his mouth preserves his life; whoever opens his lips wide comes to ruin.
The lazy person craves and gets nothing, but the diligent are fully satisfied.
The righteous hate what is false, but the wicked bring shame and disgrace.
Righteousness guards the one whose way is blameless, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.
One pretends to be rich, yet has nothing; another pretends to be poor, yet has great wealth.
Wealth is the ransom for a person's life, but the poor hear no threat.
The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked will be snuffed out.
Pride brings only strife, but wisdom is with those who take advice.
Wealth gained from nothing dwindles, but whoever gathers little by little makes it grow.
Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but a desire fulfilled is a tree of life.
Whoever despises the word will pay for it, but whoever respects the command will be rewarded.
The instruction of the wise is a fountain of life, for turning away from the snares of death.
Good sense wins favor, but the way of the treacherous is hard.
Every prudent person acts with knowledge, but a fool spreads out his folly.
A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a faithful envoy brings healing.
Poverty and disgrace come to whoever ignores discipline, but whoever heeds correction will be honored.
Desire fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but turning away from evil is detestable to fools.
Whoever walks with the wise becomes wise, but the companion of fools will suffer harm.
Trouble pursues sinners, but good rewards the righteous.
A good person leaves an inheritance to his grandchildren, but the sinner's wealth is stored up for the righteous.
The unplowed field of the poor yields much food, but it is swept away by injustice.
Whoever spares his rod hates his son, but whoever loves him is careful to discipline him.
The righteous eats until he is satisfied, but the stomach of the wicked goes hungry.
The wise woman builds her house, but folly tears it down with her own hands.
Whoever walks uprightly fears the LORD, but whoever is devious in his ways despises him.
In the mouth of a fool is a rod for his pride, but the lips of the wise protect them.
Where there are no oxen, the manger is clean, but much produce comes by the strength of an ox.
A faithful witness does not lie, but a false witness breathes out lies.
A mocker seeks wisdom and finds none, but knowledge comes easily to the discerning.
Leave the presence of a fool, for you will not find words of knowledge on his lips.
The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.
Fools mock at making amends, but among the upright there is goodwill.
The heart knows its own bitterness, and no stranger shares in its joy.
The house of the wicked will be destroyed, but the tent of the upright will flourish.
There is a way that seems right to a person, but in the end it leads to death.
Even in laughter the heart may ache, and joy may end in grief.
The faithless in heart will have his fill of his own ways, and a good person of what is his.
The simple believe everything, but the prudent watch their steps.
The wise is cautious and turns away from evil, but a fool is reckless and overconfident.
A quick-tempered person does foolish things, and a man of schemes is hated.
The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
The evil bow down before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
The poor are disliked even by their neighbors, but the rich have many friends.
Whoever despises his neighbor sins, but happy is the one who is kind to the humble.
Do not those who plot evil go astray? But faithful love and truth belong to those who plan good.
In all hard work there is profit, but mere talk leads only to poverty.
The crown of the wise is their wealth, but the folly of fools is folly.
