But the children rebelled against me. They did not walk in my decrees or keep my rulings by doing them, by which a person who does them will live, and they profaned my Sabbaths. Then I said I would pour out my fury on them and spend my anger against them in the wilderness.
But I held back my hand and acted for the sake of my name, so that it would not be profaned in the sight of the nations in whose sight I had brought them out.
Moreover, I raised my hand to them in the wilderness, swearing that I would scatter them among the nations and disperse them through the countries,
because they had not carried out my rulings, but had rejected my decrees and profaned my Sabbaths, and their eyes were set on the idols of their fathers.
So I also gave them decrees that were not good and rulings by which they could not live.
I made them unclean through their gifts, when they offered up every firstborn, so that I might devastate them, so that they would know that I am the LORD.
Therefore, son of man, speak to the house of Israel and say to them: This is what the Lord GOD says: In this also your ancestors blasphemed me, by acting unfaithfully against me.

When I brought them into the land that I had raised my hand to give them, wherever they saw any high hill or any leafy tree, there they offered their sacrifices, there they presented the offerings that provoked me, there they offered their pleasing aromas, and there they poured out their drink offerings.
So I said to them, "What is this high place that you go to?" And it is called Bamah to this day.
Therefore say to the house of Israel: This is what the Lord GOD says: Will you defile yourselves in the way your ancestors did, and play the prostitute after their vile idols?

When you offer your gifts, making your sons pass through the fire, you defile yourselves with all your idols to this day. So should I let myself be consulted by you, house of Israel? As I live, declares the Lord GOD, I will not let myself be consulted by you.
What you have in mind will never happen, when you say, "We will be like the nations, like the clans of the lands, serving wood and stone."
As I live, declares the Lord GOD, with a strong hand and an outstretched arm and with fury poured out, I will be king over you.
I will bring you out from the peoples and gather you from the countries where you have been scattered, with a strong hand and an outstretched arm and with fury poured out.
I will bring you into the wilderness of the peoples, and there I will enter into judgment with you face to face.
As I entered into judgment with your ancestors in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will enter into judgment with you, declares the Lord GOD.
I will make you pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant.

I will purge from among you those who rebel and transgress against me. I will bring them out of the land where they live as foreigners, but they will not enter the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

As for you, house of Israel, this is what the Lord GOD says: Go, each of you, serve your idols, now and hereafter, if you will not listen to me; but you will no longer profane my holy name with your gifts and your idols.

For on my holy mountain, on the high mountain of Israel, declares the Lord GOD, there the whole house of Israel, all of them, will serve me in the land. There I will accept them, and there I will require your contributions and the choicest of your gifts, with all your holy offerings.

I will accept you as a pleasing aroma, when I bring you out from the peoples and gather you from the countries where you have been scattered, and I will show myself holy among you in the sight of the nations.
Then you will know that I am the LORD, when I bring you into the land of Israel, the land I raised my hand to give to your ancestors.
There you will remember your ways and all your deeds by which you defiled yourselves, and you will loathe yourselves for all the evil you have done.
Then you will know that I am the LORD, when I deal with you for the sake of my name, not according to your evil ways or your corrupt deeds, house of Israel, declares the Lord GOD.
The word of the LORD came to me:
Son of man, set your face toward the south; preach against the south, and prophesy against the forest of the countryside in the Negev.

Say to the forest of the Negev: Hear the word of the LORD. This is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am about to set a fire in you, and it will consume every green tree in you and every dry tree. The blazing flame will not be put out, and every face from south to north will be scorched by it.
All people will see that I, the LORD, have kindled it; it will not be put out.
Then I said, "Ah, Lord GOD! They are saying of me, 'Is he not just telling parables?'"
The word of the LORD came to me:
Son of man, set your face toward Jerusalem; preach against the sanctuaries, and prophesy against the land of Israel.
Say to the land of Israel: This is what the LORD says: Look, I am against you. I will draw my sword from its sheath and cut off from you both righteous and wicked.
Because I will cut off from you righteous and wicked, my sword will go out from its sheath against all people from south to north.
All people will know that I, the LORD, have drawn my sword from its sheath; it will not go back again.
As for you, son of man, groan! Groan with breaking heart and bitter grief before their eyes.

When they ask you, "Why are you groaning?" you are to say: Because of the news that is coming. Every heart will melt and every hand go limp; every spirit will faint and every knee turn to water. Look, it is coming, and it will happen, declares the Lord GOD.
The word of the LORD came to me:
Son of man, prophesy and say: This is what the Lord says: Say: A sword, a sword is sharpened, and polished too.
It is sharpened for slaughter, polished to flash like lightning! Or shall we rejoice? The scepter of my son despises every tree.
It has been given to be polished, to be grasped in the hand. The sword is sharpened and it is polished, to be put into the hand of the killer.
Cry out and wail, son of man, for it is against my people; it is against all the princes of Israel. They are thrown to the sword along with my people. Therefore strike your thigh.
For it is a test. And what if even the scepter that despises does not continue? declares the Lord GOD.
As for you, son of man, prophesy, and strike your hands together. Let the sword strike twice, even three times. It is a sword for the slain, the sword for the great slaughter, which surrounds them,
so that hearts may melt and many may stumble. At all their gates I have set the slaughter of the sword. Ah! It is made to flash like lightning; it is drawn for slaughter.
Cut sharply to the right! Turn to the left! Go wherever your edge is directed.
I too will strike my hands together, and I will satisfy my fury. I, the LORD, have spoken.
The word of the LORD came to me:
As for you, son of man, mark out two roads for the sword of the king of Babylon to come by. Both of them are to start from the same land. Make a signpost; make it at the head of the road to a city.
Mark out a road for the sword to come to Rabbah of the Ammonites, and another to Judah, to Jerusalem the fortified.
For the king of Babylon stands at the fork in the road, at the head of the two roads, to practice divination. He shakes the arrows, he consults the household gods, he examines the liver.

Into his right hand comes the lot for Jerusalem: to set up battering rams, to open the mouth for slaughter, to raise the battle cry, to set battering rams against the gates, to pile up a ramp, to build a siege wall.
But to them it will seem a false divination, since they have sworn solemn oaths. But he will bring their guilt to remembrance, so that they will be captured.

Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Because you have brought your guilt to remembrance, by your open transgressions, so that your sins are seen in all your deeds, because you have been brought to remembrance, you will be taken by force.
And you, profane and wicked prince of Israel, whose day has come, the time of final punishment,
this is what the Lord GOD says: Remove the turban, take off the crown! Things will not stay as they are. Raise up what is low, and bring down what is high.
A ruin, a ruin, a ruin I will make it! This too will not be, until he comes to whom judgment belongs, and I will give it to him.

As for you, son of man, prophesy and say: This is what the Lord GOD says about the Ammonites and their taunts: Say: A sword, a sword is drawn for slaughter, polished to consume, to flash like lightning,
while they see false visions for you and divine lies for you, to lay you on the necks of the slain, the wicked whose day has come, the time of final punishment.
Return it to its sheath! In the place where you were created, in the land of your origin, I will judge you.
I will pour out my indignation on you; I will blow on you with the fire of my wrath, and I will hand you over to brutal men, skilled in destruction.
You will be fuel for the fire; your blood will be in the middle of the land. You will no longer be remembered, for I, the LORD, have spoken.
The word of the LORD came to me:
As for you, son of man, will you judge? Will you judge the city of bloodshed? Then make known to her all her detestable practices.
Say: This is what the Lord GOD says: A city that sheds blood in her midst, so that her time comes, and that makes idols for herself, to defile herself!

You have become guilty by the blood you have shed, and you have defiled yourself with the idols you have made. You have brought your days near, and you have come to the end of your years. Therefore I have made you a disgrace to the nations and an object of mockery to all the countries.
Those who are near and those who are far from you will mock you, you with a defiled name, full of turmoil.
Look, the princes of Israel in you, each using his power, have been intent on shedding blood.
In you father and mother are treated with contempt; in your midst the foreigner is oppressed; in you the fatherless and the widow are wronged.
You have despised my holy things and profaned my Sabbaths.
In you are slanderers intent on shedding blood; in you are those who eat on the mountains; in your midst they commit lewdness.
In you they uncover their fathers' nakedness; in you they violate women who are unclean in their menstruation.
One man commits a detestable act with his neighbor's wife; another lewdly defiles his daughter-in-law; and another in you violates his sister, his father's daughter.
In you they take bribes to shed blood. You take interest and profit, and you make gain from your neighbors by extortion. And you have forgotten me, declares the Lord GOD.
Look, I strike my hands together at the dishonest gain you have made and at the blood that is in your midst.
Can your heart endure, or can your hands be strong, in the days when I deal with you? I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will do it.
I will disperse you among the nations and scatter you through the countries, and I will put an end to your uncleanness.
You will be profaned through your own doing in the sight of the nations, and you will know that I am the LORD.
The word of the LORD came to me:
Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to me. All of them are copper, tin, iron and lead in the furnace; they have become the dross of silver.
Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Because all of you have become dross, look, I am going to gather you into the middle of Jerusalem.

As silver, copper, iron, lead and tin are gathered into the middle of a furnace to blow fire on them and melt them, so I will gather you in my anger and in my fury, and I will put you there and melt you.
I will gather you and blow on you with the fire of my wrath, and you will be melted in it.
As silver is melted in a furnace, so you will be melted in it. Then you will know that I, the LORD, have poured out my fury on you.
The word of the LORD came to me:
Son of man, say to her: You are a land that has not been cleansed, that has had no rain on the day of indignation.
There is a conspiracy of her prophets in her midst, like a roaring lion tearing its prey. They devour people, they take treasure and precious things, they make many widows in her midst.

Her priests do violence to my instruction and profane my holy things. They make no distinction between the holy and the common, and they do not teach the difference between the unclean and the clean. They shut their eyes to my Sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.
Her officials within her are like wolves tearing their prey, shedding blood and destroying lives to get dishonest gain.
Her prophets cover over these deeds with whitewash for them, seeing false visions and divining lies for them, saying, "This is what the Lord GOD says," when the LORD has not spoken.
The people of the land practice extortion and commit robbery. They oppress the poor and needy and extort from the foreigner without justice.
I looked for a man among them who would build up the wall and stand in the breach before me for the land, so that I would not destroy it, but I found no one.
So I have poured out my indignation on them; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath. I have brought their ways down on their heads, declares the Lord GOD.
The word of the LORD came to me:
Son of man, there were two women, daughters of one mother.
They played the prostitute in Egypt; in their youth they played the prostitute. There their breasts were squeezed, and there their virgin nipples were fondled.
Their names were Oholah, the older, and Oholibah her sister. They became mine, and they bore sons and daughters. As for their names, Oholah is Samaria, and Oholibah is Jerusalem.
Oholah played the prostitute while she was mine. She lusted after her lovers, the Assyrians, warriors
clothed in blue, governors and commanders, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding on horses.
She gave herself as a prostitute to them, the choicest men of Assyria, all of them, and she defiled herself with everyone she lusted after, with all their idols.
She did not give up the prostitution she had practiced since Egypt, for in her youth men had lain with her, fondled her virgin nipples, and poured out their lust on her.
Therefore I handed her over to her lovers, to the Assyrians, after whom she lusted.
They uncovered her nakedness, took her sons and her daughters, and killed her with the sword. She became a byword among women, because judgments were carried out on her.
Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet she was more corrupt than she in her lust, and in her prostitution she was worse than her sister.
She lusted after the Assyrians, governors and commanders, warriors clothed in splendor, horsemen riding on horses, all of them desirable young men.
I saw that she had defiled herself; both of them went the same way.
But she carried her prostitution further. She saw men carved on the wall, images of Chaldeans drawn in red,
with belts around their waists and flowing turbans on their heads, all of them looking like officers, in the likeness of Babylonians whose native land is Chaldea.
As soon as she saw them, she lusted after them, and she sent messengers to them in Chaldea.
The Babylonians came to her, to the bed of love, and defiled her with their lust. After she had been defiled by them, she turned away from them in disgust.
When she carried on her prostitution openly and exposed her nakedness, I turned away from her in disgust, just as I had turned away from her sister.
Yet she multiplied her prostitution, remembering the days of her youth, when she played the prostitute in the land of Egypt.
She lusted after their paramours, whose genitals were like those of donkeys and whose emission was like that of horses.
So you longed for the lewdness of your youth, when men from Egypt fondled your nipples for the sake of your young breasts.

Therefore, Oholibah, this is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am going to stir up your lovers against you, those from whom you turned away in disgust, and I will bring them against you from every side:

the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, Pekod and Shoa and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them, desirable young men, governors and commanders all of them, officers and men of renown, all of them riding on horses.

They will come against you with weapons, chariots and wagons, and with a horde of peoples. They will set themselves against you on every side with large shields, small shields and helmets. I will hand you over to them for judgment, and they will judge you by their own standards.

I will direct my jealousy against you, and they will deal with you in fury. They will cut off your nose and your ears, and those of you who are left will fall by the sword. They will take your sons and your daughters, and those of you who are left will be consumed by fire.
They will strip you of your clothes and take your beautiful jewels.
I will put an end to your lewdness and to the prostitution you brought from the land of Egypt. You will not lift up your eyes to them, nor remember Egypt anymore.
For this is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am going to hand you over to those you hate, to those from whom you turned away in disgust.
They will deal with you in hatred and take away everything you have worked for, and leave you naked and bare. The nakedness of your prostitution will be exposed, your lewdness and your prostitution.
These things will be done to you because you played the prostitute with the nations and defiled yourself with their idols.
You have walked in the way of your sister, so I will put her cup into your hand.
This is what the Lord GOD says: You will drink your sister's cup, deep and wide. You will be laughed at and mocked, for it holds so much.
You will be filled with drunkenness and sorrow. It is a cup of horror and desolation, the cup of your sister Samaria.
You will drink it and drain it; you will gnaw its broken pieces and tear your breasts. For I have spoken, declares the Lord GOD.
Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Because you have forgotten me and thrown me behind your back, you too must bear the penalty of your lewdness and your prostitution.
The LORD said to me: Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then declare to them their detestable practices.
For they have committed adultery, and blood is on their hands. They have committed adultery with their idols, and they have even offered up to them as food the sons they bore to me.
Moreover, they have done this to me: on that same day they defiled my sanctuary and profaned my Sabbaths.
When they had slaughtered their children for their idols, on that same day they came into my sanctuary to profane it. Look, that is what they did in the middle of my house.
They even sent for men who came from far away, to whom a messenger was sent; and look, they came. For them you bathed yourself, painted your eyes, and adorned yourself with jewelry.
You sat on a splendid couch, with a table spread before it, on which you had set my incense and my oil.
The sound of a carefree crowd was there. Along with men from the common crowd, Sabeans were brought from the wilderness. They put bracelets on the women's arms and beautiful crowns on their heads.
Then I said of her who was worn out by adulteries, "Now they will use her as a prostitute, her too."
They went in to her as men go in to a prostitute. So they went in to Oholah and to Oholibah, the lewd women.
But righteous men will judge them with the sentence for adulteresses and the sentence for women who shed blood, because they are adulteresses and blood is on their hands.
For this is what the Lord GOD says: Bring up a mob against them, and hand them over to terror and plunder.
The mob will stone them and cut them down with their swords. They will kill their sons and their daughters and burn their houses with fire.
So I will put an end to lewdness in the land, so that all women may take warning and not imitate your lewdness.
They will bring your lewdness down on you, and you will bear the penalty for your sins with your idols. Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.
In the ninth year, in the tenth month, on the tenth day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me:
Son of man, write down the name of the day, this very day. The king of Babylon has laid siege to Jerusalem this very day.
Tell the rebellious house a parable and say to them: This is what the Lord GOD says: Put on the pot, put it on, and pour water into it.
Put into it the pieces of meat, all the good pieces, the thigh and the shoulder. Fill it with the choicest bones.
Take the choicest of the flock, and pile the bones under it. Bring it to a rolling boil, and let its bones cook in it.
Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Woe to the city of bloodshed, the pot whose rust is in it, whose rust has not gone out of it! Empty it piece by piece; no lot has fallen on it.
For the blood she shed is in her midst. She put it on a bare rock; she did not pour it out on the ground to cover it with dust.
To stir up fury and take vengeance, I have put her blood on a bare rock, so that it will not be covered.
Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Woe to the city of bloodshed! I too will make the pile of wood great.
Heap on the logs, kindle the fire, cook the meat well, mix in the spices, and let the bones be charred.
Then set it empty on its coals, so that it becomes hot and its copper glows, so that its uncleanness may melt in it and its rust be consumed.
It has worn me out with toil, yet its thick rust does not go out of it. Into the fire with its rust!
Your uncleanness is lewdness. Because I tried to cleanse you, but you would not be cleansed from your uncleanness, you will not be clean again until I have satisfied my fury on you.

I, the LORD, have spoken. It is coming, and I will do it. I will not hold back, I will not spare, and I will not relent. According to your ways and your deeds they will judge you, declares the Lord GOD.
The word of the LORD came to me:
Son of man, look, I am about to take from you the delight of your eyes with a sudden blow, but you must not mourn or weep or shed any tears.
Groan in silence; do not perform mourning rites for the dead. Bind on your turban, put your sandals on your feet, do not cover your upper lip, and do not eat the bread of others.
So I spoke to the people in the morning, and in the evening my wife died. The next morning I did as I was commanded.
The people said to me, "Will you not tell us what these things you are doing mean for us?"
So I said to them, "The word of the LORD came to me:

Say to the house of Israel: This is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am about to profane my sanctuary, the pride of your strength, the delight of your eyes and the longing of your heart. The sons and daughters you left behind will fall by the sword.
And you will do as I have done. You will not cover your upper lip or eat the bread of others.
Your turbans will be on your heads and your sandals on your feet. You will not mourn or weep, but you will waste away because of your guilt and groan to one another.
So Ezekiel will be a sign for you; you will do just as he has done. When this comes, you will know that I am the Lord GOD."
As for you, son of man, on the day I take from them their stronghold, their joy and glory, the delight of their eyes and their heart's desire, their sons and their daughters,
on that day a survivor will come to you to bring the news.
On that day your mouth will be opened to the survivor; you will speak and no longer be silent. So you will be a sign for them, and they will know that I am the LORD.
The word of the LORD came to me:
Son of man, set your face toward the Ammonites and prophesy against them.

Say to the Ammonites: Hear the word of the Lord GOD. This is what the Lord GOD says: Because you said, "Aha!" over my sanctuary when it was profaned, and over the land of Israel when it was made desolate, and over the house of Judah when they went into exile,

therefore, look, I am going to hand you over to the people of the east as a possession. They will set up their camps among you and pitch their tents among you. They will eat your fruit and drink your milk.
I will make Rabbah a pasture for camels, and the land of Ammon a resting place for flocks. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
For this is what the Lord GOD says: Because you clapped your hands and stamped your feet and rejoiced with all the contempt in your heart over the land of Israel,

therefore, look, I have stretched out my hand against you, and I will hand you over as plunder to the nations. I will cut you off from the peoples and make you perish from the countries; I will destroy you. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
This is what the Lord GOD says: Because Moab and Seir said, "Look, the house of Judah is like all the other nations,"
therefore, look, I am going to lay open the flank of Moab, stripping it of its cities, the cities on its frontier, the glory of the land: Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon and Kiriathaim.
I will give it, along with the Ammonites, to the people of the east as a possession, so that the Ammonites will not be remembered among the nations.
And I will carry out judgments on Moab. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
This is what the Lord GOD says: Because Edom acted vengefully against the house of Judah, and incurred great guilt by taking revenge on them,
therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: I will stretch out my hand against Edom and cut off from it both people and animals. I will make it a ruin; from Teman to Dedan they will fall by the sword.
I will lay my vengeance on Edom by the hand of my people Israel, and they will deal with Edom according to my anger and my fury. Then they will know my vengeance, declares the Lord GOD.
This is what the Lord GOD says: Because the Philistines acted in revenge and took vengeance with contempt in their hearts, destroying with endless hostility,
therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am going to stretch out my hand against the Philistines. I will cut off the Cherethites and destroy the rest of those on the seacoast.
I will carry out great vengeance on them with furious punishments. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I lay my vengeance on them.
In the eleventh year, on the first day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me:
Son of man, because Tyre has said about Jerusalem, "Aha! The gateway of the peoples is broken; it has swung open to me. I will be filled, now that she is laid waste,"
therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am against you, Tyre, and I will bring up many nations against you, as the sea brings up its waves.
They will destroy the walls of Tyre and tear down her towers. I will scrape her soil from her and make her a bare rock.
She will become a place for spreading nets in the middle of the sea, for I have spoken, declares the Lord GOD. She will become plunder for the nations,
and her daughters on the mainland will be killed by the sword. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
For this is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am going to bring against Tyre from the north Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, with horses and chariots, with horsemen and a great army.
He will kill your daughters on the mainland with the sword. He will build a siege wall against you, pile up a ramp against you, and raise a roof of shields against you.
He will direct the blows of his battering ram against your walls and break down your towers with his axes.

His horses will be so many that their dust will cover you. Your walls will shake at the noise of horsemen, wagons and chariots, when he enters your gates as people enter a city that has been breached.
With the hoofs of his horses he will trample all your streets. He will kill your people with the sword, and your mighty pillars will fall to the ground.
They will plunder your wealth and loot your merchandise. They will tear down your walls and destroy your fine houses, and they will throw your stones, your timber and your soil into the water.
I will put an end to the noise of your songs, and the sound of your lyres will be heard no more.
I will make you a bare rock; you will be a place for spreading nets. You will never be rebuilt, for I, the LORD, have spoken, declares the Lord GOD.
This is what the Lord GOD says to Tyre: Will not the coastlands shake at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan, when the slaughter is carried out in your midst?

Then all the princes of the sea will come down from their thrones, take off their robes and strip off their embroidered clothes. They will clothe themselves with trembling; they will sit on the ground, tremble every moment and be appalled over you.

They will take up a lament over you and say to you, "How you have perished, you who were peopled from the seas, the renowned city, which was mighty on the sea, she and her inhabitants, who spread their terror over all who lived there!
Now the coastlands tremble on the day of your fall; the coastlands by the sea are terrified at your passing."
For this is what the Lord GOD says: When I make you a desolate city, like cities that are not inhabited, when I bring up the deep over you and the great waters cover you,

then I will bring you down with those who go down to the Pit, to the people of long ago. I will make you live in the world below, among ruins from long ago, with those who go down to the Pit, so that you will not be inhabited; and I will give glory in the land of the living.
I will bring you to a dreadful end, and you will be no more. You will be sought, but you will never be found again, declares the Lord GOD.
The word of the LORD came to me:
You, son of man, raise a lament over Tyre.
Say to Tyre, who lives at the gateway to the sea, trader to the peoples of many coastlands: This is what the Lord GOD says: Tyre, you have said, "I am perfect in beauty."
Your borders are in the heart of the seas; your builders made your beauty perfect.
They built all your planks of juniper from Senir; they took a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for you.
They made your oars of oaks from Bashan; they made your deck of ivory set in cypress from the coastlands of Kittim.
Your sail was fine linen with embroidery from Egypt, to serve as your banner. Your awning was blue and purple cloth from the coastlands of Elishah.
The people of Sidon and Arvad were your rowers. Your own skilled men, Tyre, were in you; they were your helmsmen.
The elders of Gebal and its skilled men were in you, repairing your seams. All the ships of the sea and their sailors were in you, to trade for your merchandise.
Persia, Lud and Put were in your army, your men of war. They hung shield and helmet in you; they gave you your splendor.
The men of Arvad and your army were on your walls all around, and the Gammadim were in your towers. They hung their shields on your walls all around; they made your beauty perfect.
Tarshish traded with you because of your great wealth of every kind. They gave silver, iron, tin and lead for your wares.
Javan, Tubal and Meshech were your merchants. They gave human beings and articles of bronze for your merchandise.
From Beth-togarmah they gave horses, war horses and mules for your wares.
The men of Dedan were your merchants. Many coastlands were your markets; they paid you with ivory tusks and ebony.
Aram traded with you because of your many products. They gave turquoise, purple cloth, embroidered work, fine linen, coral and rubies for your wares.
Judah and the land of Israel were your merchants. They gave wheat from Minnith, pannag, honey, oil and balm for your merchandise.
Damascus traded with you because of your many products and your great wealth of every kind, in wine from Helbon and wool from Zahar.
Vedan and Javan from Uzal paid for your wares: wrought iron, cassia and cane were among your merchandise.
Dedan was your merchant in saddlecloths for riding.
Arabia and all the princes of Kedar were your dealers. In lambs, rams and goats, in these they traded with you.
The merchants of Sheba and Raamah were your merchants. They gave the finest of all spices, every kind of precious stone, and gold for your wares.
Haran, Canneh and Eden, the merchants of Sheba, Asshur and Kilmad were your merchants.
They were your merchants in fine garments, in cloaks of blue cloth and embroidered work, and in carpets of many colors, bound with cords and made secure, in your marketplace.
The ships of Tarshish carried your merchandise. You were filled and heavily laden in the heart of the seas.
Your rowers have brought you out into the mighty waters. The east wind has wrecked you in the heart of the seas.

Your wealth, your wares and your merchandise, your sailors and your helmsmen, those who repair your seams and those who trade your merchandise, and all your men of war who are in you, with all the company that is within you, will fall into the heart of the seas on the day of your downfall.
At the sound of the cry of your helmsmen the shorelands will shake.
All who handle the oar will come down from their ships. The sailors and all the helmsmen of the sea will stand on the shore.
They will raise their voices over you and cry out bitterly. They will throw dust on their heads and roll in the ashes.
They will shave their heads bald for you and put on sackcloth. They will weep over you in bitterness of soul, with bitter mourning.
In their wailing they will raise a lament for you and lament over you: "Who was like Tyre, like one silenced in the middle of the sea?
When your wares went out from the seas, you satisfied many peoples. With your great wealth and your merchandise you made the kings of the earth rich.
Now that you are wrecked by the seas, in the depths of the waters, your merchandise and all the company within you have gone down.
All the inhabitants of the coastlands are appalled at you. Their kings shudder with horror; their faces are contorted.
The traders among the peoples hiss at you. You have come to a dreadful end, and you will be no more, forever."
The word of the LORD came to me:

Son of man, say to the ruler of Tyre: This is what the Lord GOD says: Because your heart is proud, and you have said, "I am a god; I sit on the seat of the gods in the heart of the seas," though you are a human being and not a god, and you count your mind as the mind of a god,
look, you are wiser than Daniel! No secret is hidden from you.
By your wisdom and your understanding you have gained wealth for yourself, and you have gathered gold and silver into your treasuries.
By your great wisdom in trade you have increased your wealth, and your heart has grown proud because of your wealth.
Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Because you count your mind as the mind of a god,
I am going to bring foreigners against you, the most ruthless of the nations. They will draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom and defile your splendor.
They will bring you down to the Pit, and you will die the death of the slain in the heart of the seas.
Will you still say, "I am a god," in the presence of the one who kills you? You are a human being and not a god, in the hands of those who strike you down.
You will die the death of the uncircumcised by the hand of foreigners, for I have spoken, declares the Lord GOD.
The word of the LORD came to me:
Son of man, raise a lament over the king of Tyre and say to him: This is what the Lord GOD says: You were the seal of perfection, full of wisdom and perfect in beauty.

You were in Eden, the garden of God. Every precious stone was your covering: carnelian, chrysolite and moonstone, beryl, onyx and jasper, lapis lazuli, turquoise and emerald, and gold. The workmanship of your settings and your mountings was in you; on the day you were created they were prepared.
You were an anointed guardian cherub. I placed you; you were on the holy mountain of God. You walked among the stones of fire.
You were blameless in your ways from the day you were created, until wrongdoing was found in you.

Through your great trade you were filled with violence within, and you sinned. So I banished you in disgrace from the mountain of God, and I destroyed you, guardian cherub, from among the stones of fire.
Your heart grew proud because of your beauty; you corrupted your wisdom for the sake of your splendor. I threw you to the ground. I exposed you before kings, for them to gaze at you.

By your great guilt, by the dishonesty of your trade, you defiled your sanctuaries. So I brought out fire from within you, and it consumed you. I turned you to ashes on the earth in the sight of all who saw you.
All who knew you among the peoples are appalled at you. You have come to a dreadful end, and you will be no more, forever.
The word of the LORD came to me:
Son of man, set your face toward Sidon and prophesy against it.

Say: This is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am against you, Sidon, and I will display my glory within you. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I carry out judgments on her and show myself holy in her.
I will send plague into her and bloodshed into her streets. The slain will fall within her, by the sword that is against her on every side. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
The house of Israel will no longer have a prickling brier or a painful thorn among all their neighbors who treat them with contempt. Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD.

This is what the Lord GOD says: When I gather the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they have been scattered, I will show myself holy among them in the sight of the nations. They will live in their own land, which I gave to my servant Jacob.

They will live in it securely. They will build houses and plant vineyards and live securely, when I carry out judgments on all their neighbors who treat them with contempt. Then they will know that I am the LORD their God.
In the tenth year, in the tenth month, on the twelfth day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me:
Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him and against all Egypt.

Speak and say: This is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great monster lying in the middle of his streams, who has said, "My Nile is my own; I made it for myself."
I will put hooks in your jaws and make the fish of your streams stick to your scales. I will haul you up out of your streams, with all the fish of your streams sticking to your scales.

I will leave you in the wilderness, you and all the fish of your streams. You will fall on the open field; you will not be gathered up or collected. I have given you as food to the animals of the earth and the birds of the sky.
Then all the inhabitants of Egypt will know that I am the LORD. Because they have been a staff of reed for the house of Israel,
when they grasped you by the hand, you splintered and tore open all their shoulders; and when they leaned on you, you broke and made all their backs go rigid.
Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: I am going to bring a sword against you, and I will cut off from you both human beings and animals.
The land of Egypt will become a desolate waste. Then they will know that I am the LORD. Because he said, "The Nile is mine; I made it,"
therefore, look, I am against you and against your streams. I will make the land of Egypt an utter ruin, a desolate waste, from Migdol to Syene, as far as the border of Cush.
No human foot will pass through it, and no animal's foot will pass through it. It will be uninhabited for forty years.

I will make the land of Egypt a desolation among desolate lands, and its cities will lie desolate among ruined cities for forty years. I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them among the countries.
For this is what the Lord GOD says: At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the peoples among whom they were scattered.
I will restore the fortunes of Egypt and bring them back to the land of Pathros, the land of their origin. There they will be a lowly kingdom.
It will be the lowliest of the kingdoms, and it will never again exalt itself above the nations. I will make them so few that they will not rule over the nations.
Egypt will never again be the confidence of the house of Israel; it will only bring their guilt to mind, when they turned to them for help. Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD.
In the twenty-seventh year, in the first month, on the first day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me:

Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon made his army labor hard against Tyre. Every head was rubbed bald, and every shoulder was rubbed raw. Yet he and his army got no wages from Tyre for the labor he had done against it.

Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: I am going to give the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. He will carry off its wealth, plunder its spoil and seize its loot, and it will be the wages for his army.
As his payment for the labor he performed against it, I have given him the land of Egypt, because they did it for me, declares the Lord GOD.
On that day I will make a horn sprout for the house of Israel, and I will open your mouth among them. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
The word of the LORD came to me:
Son of man, prophesy and say: This is what the Lord GOD says: Wail, "Alas for the day!"
For the day is near, the day of the LORD is near. It will be a day of clouds, a time of doom for the nations.
A sword will come against Egypt, and anguish will be in Cush, when the slain fall in Egypt, and they carry off her wealth, and her foundations are torn down.
Cush, Put and Lud, all the mixed peoples, Kub, and the people of the land of the covenant will fall with them by the sword.
This is what the LORD says: Those who support Egypt will fall, and her proud strength will come down. From Migdol to Syene they will fall in her by the sword, declares the Lord GOD.
They will be desolate among desolate lands, and her cities will lie among ruined cities.
Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I set fire to Egypt and all her helpers are crushed.
On that day messengers will go out from me in ships to terrify Cush in its complacency. Anguish will come on them on the day of Egypt's doom, for look, it is coming!
This is what the Lord GOD says: I will put an end to the hordes of Egypt by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
He and his people with him, the most ruthless of the nations, will be brought in to destroy the land. They will draw their swords against Egypt and fill the land with the slain.
I will make the streams dry land and sell the land into the hands of evil men. By the hands of foreigners I will lay waste the land and everything in it. I, the LORD, have spoken.

This is what the Lord GOD says: I will destroy the idols and put an end to the worthless gods of Memphis. There will no longer be a prince from the land of Egypt, and I will put fear in the land of Egypt.
I will make Pathros desolate, set fire to Zoan and carry out judgments on Thebes.
I will pour out my wrath on Sin, the stronghold of Egypt, and cut off the hordes of Thebes.
I will set fire to Egypt. Sin will writhe in anguish, Thebes will be breached, and Memphis will face enemies by day.
The young men of Aven and Pi-beseth will fall by the sword, and the cities themselves will go into captivity.
In Tehaphnehes the day will grow dark when I break the yokes of Egypt there, and her proud strength comes to an end in her. A cloud will cover her, and her daughters will go into captivity.
So I will carry out judgments on Egypt. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
In the eleventh year, in the first month, on the seventh day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me:
Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt. Look, it has not been bound up for healing; no bandage has been put on it to bind it and make it strong enough to grasp the sword.
Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt. I will break his arms, both the strong one and the broken one, and make the sword fall from his hand.
I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them among the countries.
I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon and put my sword in his hand, but I will break the arms of Pharaoh, and he will groan before him with the groans of a man mortally wounded.

I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, but the arms of Pharaoh will drop. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon and he stretches it out against the land of Egypt.
I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them among the countries. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
In the eleventh year, in the third month, on the first day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me:
Son of man, say to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his hordes: Whom are you like in your greatness?
Look, Assyria was a cedar in Lebanon, with beautiful branches and shady foliage, towering high, with its top among the clouds.
The waters made it grow; the deep made it tall. The deep sent its rivers flowing all around the place where it was planted, and sent out its channels to all the trees of the field.
So it towered higher than all the trees of the field. Its boughs grew many and its branches grew long, because of the abundant waters as it spread them out.
All the birds of the sky nested in its boughs; all the animals of the field gave birth under its branches; and all the great nations lived in its shade.
It was beautiful in its greatness, in the length of its branches, for its roots went down to abundant waters.

The cedars in the garden of God could not rival it; the junipers could not compare with its boughs, and the plane trees were nothing like its branches. No tree in the garden of God was like it in its beauty.
I made it beautiful with its many branches, and all the trees of Eden, which were in the garden of God, envied it.
Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Because you towered so high, and it set its top among the clouds, and its heart grew proud of its height,
I handed it over to the ruler of the nations, who was sure to deal with it as its wickedness deserved. I drove it out.

Foreigners, the most ruthless of the nations, cut it down and left it. On the mountains and in all the valleys its branches fell, and its boughs lay broken in all the ravines of the land. All the peoples of the earth came out from its shade and left it.
All the birds of the sky settle on its fallen trunk, and all the animals of the field are among its branches.

This is so that no trees by the waters may tower high or set their tops among the clouds, and no trees that drink water may reach up to them in height. For all of them are given over to death, to the world below, among human beings, with those who go down to the Pit.

This is what the Lord GOD says: On the day it went down to Sheol, I brought mourning: I covered the deep over it and held back its rivers, and the mighty waters were stopped. I clothed Lebanon in gloom for it, and all the trees of the field wilted because of it.

I made the nations quake at the sound of its fall, when I brought it down to Sheol with those who go down to the Pit. And all the trees of Eden, the choicest and best of Lebanon, all the trees that drink water, were comforted in the world below.
They too went down with it to Sheol, to those killed by the sword, and so did its allies, who lived in its shade among the nations.

Which of the trees of Eden were you like in glory and greatness? Yet you will be brought down with the trees of Eden to the world below. You will lie among the uncircumcised, with those killed by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his hordes, declares the Lord GOD.
In the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, on the first day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me:

Son of man, raise a lament over Pharaoh king of Egypt and say to him: You likened yourself to a lion among the nations, but you are like a monster in the seas. You thrashed about in your rivers, churned up the water with your feet and muddied their rivers.
This is what the Lord GOD says: I will spread my net over you with a company of many peoples, and they will haul you up in my dragnet.
I will throw you on the land; I will fling you on the open field. I will make all the birds of the sky settle on you, and I will fill the animals of the whole earth with you.
I will lay your flesh on the mountains and fill the valleys with your carcass.
I will drench the land with what flows from you, with your blood, up to the mountains, and the ravines will be filled with you.
When I snuff you out, I will cover the sky and darken its stars. I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon will not give its light.
All the shining lights in the sky I will darken over you, and I will bring darkness on your land, declares the Lord GOD.
I will trouble the hearts of many peoples when I bring news of your destruction among the nations, to lands you have not known.

I will make many peoples appalled at you, and their kings will shudder with horror over you when I brandish my sword before them. On the day of your downfall they will tremble every moment, each for his own life.
For this is what the Lord GOD says: The sword of the king of Babylon will come against you.
I will make your hordes fall by the swords of mighty men, all of them the most ruthless of the nations. They will devastate the pride of Egypt, and all her hordes will be destroyed.
I will destroy all her cattle from beside abundant waters. No human foot will muddy them again, and no cattle's hooves will muddy them.
Then I will let their waters settle and make their rivers run like oil, declares the Lord GOD.
When I make the land of Egypt a desolation, and the land is stripped of all that fills it, when I strike down all who live in it, then they will know that I am the LORD.
This is a lament, and they will chant it. The daughters of the nations will chant it; over Egypt and all her hordes they will chant it, declares the Lord GOD.
In the twelfth year, on the fifteenth day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me:
Son of man, wail over the hordes of Egypt, and bring them down, her and the daughters of mighty nations, to the world below, with those who go down to the Pit.
Whom do you surpass in beauty? Go down and be laid to rest with the uncircumcised!
They will fall among those killed by the sword. The sword has been handed over! Drag her away with all her hordes!
From the middle of Sheol the mightiest of the warriors will speak to him and his helpers: "They have come down; they lie still, the uncircumcised, killed by the sword."
Assyria is there with all its company, its graves all around it, all of them slain, fallen by the sword.
Its graves are set in the farthest depths of the Pit, and its company lies all around its grave, all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who spread terror in the land of the living.

Elam is there, with all its hordes around its grave, all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who went down uncircumcised to the world below, who spread their terror in the land of the living. They bear their disgrace with those who go down to the Pit.

Among the slain a bed has been made for Elam with all its hordes, its graves all around it, all of them uncircumcised, killed by the sword. For their terror was spread in the land of the living, and they bear their disgrace with those who go down to the Pit. Elam is placed among the slain.
Meshech and Tubal are there, with all their hordes, their graves all around them, all of them uncircumcised, killed by the sword, for they spread their terror in the land of the living.

They do not lie with the mighty warriors, the fallen from among the uncircumcised, who went down to Sheol with their weapons of war, whose swords were laid under their heads, and whose guilt lies on their bones, though the terror of the mighty was in the land of the living.
As for you, you will be broken among the uncircumcised and lie with those killed by the sword.
Edom is there, its kings and all its princes, who for all their might are laid with those killed by the sword. They lie with the uncircumcised, with those who go down to the Pit.

All the princes of the north are there, and all the Sidonians, who went down with the slain in shame, for all the terror their might once caused. They lie uncircumcised with those killed by the sword, and they bear their disgrace with those who go down to the Pit.
Pharaoh will see them, and he will be comforted over all his hordes, Pharaoh and all his army, killed by the sword, declares the Lord GOD.
For I spread my terror in the land of the living, but he will be laid among the uncircumcised, with those killed by the sword, Pharaoh and all his hordes, declares the Lord GOD.
The word of the LORD came to me:
Son of man, speak to your people and say to them: When I bring a sword against a land, and the people of the land take one man from among them and make him their watchman,
and he sees the sword coming against the land and blows the ram's horn and warns the people,
then if anyone hears the sound of the horn but does not take the warning, and the sword comes and takes him away, his blood will be on his own head.
He heard the sound of the horn but did not take the warning; his blood will be on himself. If he had taken the warning, he would have saved his life.

But if the watchman sees the sword coming and does not blow the horn, so that the people are not warned, and the sword comes and takes the life of any one of them, that person is taken away for his guilt, but I will hold the watchman responsible for his blood.
As for you, son of man, I have made you a watchman for the house of Israel. Whenever you hear a word from my mouth, you are to warn them from me.

When I say to the wicked, "Wicked one, you will surely die," and you do not speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked person will die for his guilt, but I will hold you responsible for his blood.
But if you warn the wicked to turn from his way, and he does not turn from his way, he will die for his guilt, but you will have saved your life.
As for you, son of man, say to the house of Israel: This is what you have been saying: "Our transgressions and our sins weigh on us, and we are wasting away because of them. How then can we live?"

Say to them: As I live, declares the Lord GOD, I take no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but rather in the wicked turning from his way and living. Turn back, turn back from your evil ways! Why should you die, house of Israel?

As for you, son of man, say to your people: The righteousness of the righteous will not save him on the day he transgresses. As for the wickedness of the wicked, he will not fall because of it on the day he turns from his wickedness. And the righteous will not be able to live by his righteousness on the day he sins.
When I tell the righteous that he will surely live, but he trusts in his righteousness and does wrong, none of his righteous deeds will be remembered; he will die for the wrong he has done.
And when I say to the wicked, "You will surely die," but he turns from his sin and does what is just and right,
if the wicked gives back what he took in pledge, repays what he has stolen, and walks in the decrees that give life, doing no wrong, he will surely live; he will not die.
None of the sins he has committed will be remembered against him. He has done what is just and right; he will surely live.
Yet your people say, "The way of the Lord is not fair." But it is their own way that is not fair.
When the righteous turns from his righteousness and does wrong, he will die for it.
And when the wicked turns from his wickedness and does what is just and right, he will live because of it.
Yet you say, "The way of the Lord is not fair." I will judge each of you according to his ways, house of Israel.
In the twelfth year of our exile, in the tenth month, on the fifth day of the month, a fugitive from Jerusalem came to me and said, "The city has fallen!"

Now the hand of the LORD had been on me in the evening, before the fugitive came, and he had opened my mouth by the time the man came to me in the morning. So my mouth was opened, and I was no longer silent.
The word of the LORD came to me:

Son of man, the people living in these ruins on the soil of Israel are saying, "Abraham was only one man, yet he took possession of the land. But we are many; the land has surely been given to us as our possession."
Therefore say to them: This is what the Lord GOD says: You eat meat with the blood, you lift up your eyes to your idols, and you shed blood. Should you then possess the land?
You rely on your swords, you commit detestable practices, and each of you defiles his neighbor's wife. Should you then possess the land?

Say this to them: This is what the Lord GOD says: As I live, those who are in the ruins will fall by the sword; those in the open field I will give to the wild animals to be devoured; and those in the strongholds and the caves will die of plague.
I will make the land a desolate waste, and her proud strength will come to an end. The mountains of Israel will be desolate, with no one passing through.
Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I make the land a desolate waste because of all the detestable practices they have done.

As for you, son of man, your people are talking about you beside the walls and in the doorways of the houses. They say to one another, each to his brother, "Come and hear what the word is that comes from the LORD."
They come to you as people do, and they sit before you as my people and hear your words, but they do not act on them. With their mouths they speak of love, but their hearts go after their own gain.
Look, to them you are like a love song, sung with a beautiful voice and played well on the strings. They hear your words, but they do not act on them.
But when it comes, and look, it is coming, they will know that a prophet has been among them.
The word of the LORD came to me:

Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy and say to them, to the shepherds: This is what the Lord GOD says: Woe to the shepherds of Israel, who have been feeding themselves! Should not shepherds feed the flock?
You eat the fat, you clothe yourselves with the wool, and you slaughter the fattened animals, but you do not feed the flock.

You have not strengthened the weak, you have not healed the sick, you have not bound up the injured, you have not brought back the strays, and you have not searched for the lost. With force and harshness you have ruled them.
So they were scattered for lack of a shepherd, and they became food for all the wild animals, and they were scattered.
My sheep wandered over all the mountains and on every high hill. My sheep were scattered over the whole face of the earth, with no one to look for them or search for them.
Therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the LORD:

As I live, declares the Lord GOD, because my flock has become plunder, and my flock has become food for all the wild animals for lack of a shepherd, and my shepherds have not looked for my flock, but the shepherds have fed themselves and have not fed my flock,
therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the LORD.

This is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am against the shepherds, and I will demand my flock from their hand. I will stop them from feeding the flock, and the shepherds will no longer feed themselves. I will rescue my flock from their mouths, so that they will no longer be food for them.
For this is what the Lord GOD says: I myself will search for my flock and look after them.

As a shepherd looks after his flock on the day he is among his scattered sheep, so I will look after my flock. I will rescue them from all the places where they were scattered on a day of cloud and thick darkness.

I will bring them out from the peoples and gather them from the countries, and I will bring them into their own land. I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, by the streams and in all the inhabited places of the land.

I will feed them in good pasture, and their grazing land will be on the high mountains of Israel. There they will lie down in good grazing land, and they will feed on rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.
I myself will shepherd my flock, and I myself will make them lie down, declares the Lord GOD.
I will search for the lost, bring back the strays, bind up the injured and strengthen the sick, but the fat and the strong I will destroy. I will shepherd the flock with justice.
As for you, my flock, this is what the Lord GOD says: I am going to judge between one sheep and another, between the rams and the male goats.

Is it not enough for you to feed on the good pasture, that you must trample the rest of your pasture with your feet? Is it not enough for you to drink the clear water, that you must muddy the rest with your feet?
And my flock must feed on what your feet have trampled and drink what your feet have muddied.
Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says to them: I myself will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.
Because you push with flank and shoulder, and butt all the weak with your horns until you have scattered them far away,
I will save my flock, and they will no longer be plunder. I will judge between one sheep and another.
I will set over them one shepherd, my servant David, and he will feed them. He will feed them and be their shepherd.
I, the LORD, will be their God, and my servant David will be prince among them. I, the LORD, have spoken.
I will make a covenant of peace with them and rid the land of savage beasts, so that they may live securely in the wilderness and sleep in the forests.
I will make them and the places around my hill a blessing. I will send down the rain in its season; there will be showers of blessing.

The trees of the field will yield their fruit, and the land will yield its produce, and they will be secure in their land. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I break the bars of their yoke and rescue them from the hand of those who enslaved them.
They will no longer be plunder for the nations, and the wild animals of the land will not devour them. They will live securely, and no one will make them afraid.
I will raise up for them a planting of renown, and they will no longer be swept away by famine in the land, or bear the scorn of the nations any more.
Then they will know that I, the LORD their God, am with them, and that they, the house of Israel, are my people, declares the Lord GOD.
You are my flock, the flock of my pasture. You are human beings, and I am your God, declares the Lord GOD.
The word of the LORD came to me:
Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir and prophesy against it.
Say to it: This is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am against you, Mount Seir. I will stretch out my hand against you and make you a desolate waste.
I will lay your cities in ruins, and you will become a desolation. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
Because you have kept up an ancient hostility and handed the Israelites over to the power of the sword at the time of their disaster, at the time of their final punishment,
therefore, as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I will hand you over to bloodshed, and bloodshed will pursue you. Since you did not hate bloodshed, bloodshed will pursue you.
I will make Mount Seir a desolate waste, and I will cut off from it all who come and go.
I will fill its mountains with its slain. On your hills and in your valleys and in all your ravines, those killed by the sword will fall.
I will make you a desolation forever, and your cities will never be restored. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
Because you said, "These two nations and these two lands will be mine, and we will take possession of them," though the LORD was there,
therefore, as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I will deal with you according to the anger and the jealousy you showed in your hatred against them. I will make myself known among them when I judge you.
Then you will know that I, the LORD, have heard all the contemptuous things you said against the mountains of Israel: "They are laid waste; they have been given to us to devour."
You boasted against me with your mouth and heaped up your words against me. I heard it.
This is what the Lord GOD says: While the whole earth rejoices, I will make you a desolation.

As you rejoiced over the inheritance of the house of Israel because it was laid waste, so I will do to you. You will be a desolation, Mount Seir, and all Edom, all of it. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
As for you, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel and say: Mountains of Israel, hear the word of the LORD.
This is what the Lord GOD says: Because the enemy has said of you, "Aha! The ancient heights have become our possession,"

therefore prophesy and say: This is what the Lord GOD says: Because, yes, because they made you desolate and crushed you from every side, so that you became the possession of the rest of the nations, and you have become the talk of gossips and the slander of the people,

therefore, mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD. This is what the Lord GOD says to the mountains and the hills, to the ravines and the valleys, to the desolate ruins and the abandoned cities that have become plunder and a mockery to the rest of the nations all around,

therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Surely in the fire of my jealousy I have spoken against the rest of the nations and against all Edom, who with wholehearted joy and utter contempt took my land as their own possession, so that its pastureland would be plunder.

Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and say to the mountains and the hills, to the ravines and the valleys: This is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I have spoken in my jealousy and my wrath, because you have borne the scorn of the nations.
Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: I raise my hand, swearing that the nations around you will themselves bear their scorn.
But you, mountains of Israel, will put out your branches and bear your fruit for my people Israel, for they will soon come home.
For look, I am for you; I will turn to you, and you will be plowed and sown.
I will multiply people on you, the whole house of Israel, all of it. The cities will be inhabited and the ruins rebuilt.

I will multiply human beings and animals on you, and they will increase and be fruitful. I will settle you as you were in former times and do you more good than at the beginning. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
I will make people walk on you, my people Israel. They will possess you, and you will be their inheritance, and you will never again rob them of their children.
This is what the Lord GOD says: Because people say to you, "You devour people, and you rob your nations of their children,"
therefore you will no longer devour people or rob your nations of their children, declares the Lord GOD.
I will no longer let you hear the scorn of the nations, and you will no longer bear the reproach of the peoples or make your nations stumble, declares the Lord GOD.
The word of the LORD came to me:
Son of man, when the house of Israel lived on their own soil, they defiled it by their ways and their deeds. Their way before me was like the impurity of a woman in her period.
So I poured out my wrath on them for the blood they had shed on the land, and because they had defiled it with their idols.
I scattered them among the nations, and they were dispersed among the countries. I judged them according to their ways and their deeds.
But when they came to the nations, wherever they went, they profaned my holy name, because it was said of them, "These are the people of the LORD, and yet they had to leave his land."
I was concerned for my holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations where they went.

Therefore say to the house of Israel: This is what the Lord GOD says: It is not for your sake that I am about to act, house of Israel, but for the sake of my holy name, which you have profaned among the nations where you went.

I will show the holiness of my great name, which has been profaned among the nations, which you have profaned among them. Then the nations will know that I am the LORD, declares the Lord GOD, when I show myself holy through you before their eyes.
I will take you from the nations and gather you from all the countries, and I will bring you into your own land.
I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. From all your impurities and from all your idols I will cleanse you.
I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit within you. I will remove the heart of stone from your flesh and give you a heart of flesh.
I will put my Spirit within you and make you walk in my decrees, and you will keep my rulings and carry them out.
You will live in the land I gave your ancestors. You will be my people, and I will be your God.
I will save you from all your impurities. I will summon the grain and make it plentiful, and I will not bring famine on you.
I will multiply the fruit of the trees and the produce of the field, so that you will never again suffer the disgrace of famine among the nations.
Then you will remember your evil ways and your deeds that were not good, and you will loathe yourselves for your guilt and your detestable practices.
It is not for your sake that I am acting, declares the Lord GOD; let that be known to you. Be ashamed and humiliated because of your ways, house of Israel.
This is what the Lord GOD says: On the day I cleanse you from all your guilt, I will resettle the cities, and the ruins will be rebuilt.
The desolate land will be farmed, instead of lying desolate in the sight of all who pass by.
They will say, "This land that was desolate has become like the garden of Eden, and the cities that were ruined, desolate and torn down are fortified and inhabited."
Then the nations that are left around you will know that I, the LORD, have rebuilt what was torn down and replanted what was desolate. I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will do it.
This is what the Lord GOD says: Once more I will let the house of Israel ask me to do this for them: I will multiply their people like a flock.
Like the flock for sacrifices, like the flock of Jerusalem at her appointed festivals, so the ruined cities will be filled with flocks of people. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
The hand of the LORD was on me, and he brought me out by the Spirit of the LORD and set me down in the middle of the valley. It was full of bones.
He led me all around among them, and there were very many of them on the floor of the valley, and they were very dry.
He said to me, "Son of man, can these bones live?" I said, "Lord GOD, you know."
Then he said to me, "Prophesy over these bones and say to them, 'Dry bones, hear the word of the LORD.
This is what the Lord GOD says to these bones: I am going to make breath enter you, and you will come to life.
I will put sinews on you, make flesh grow on you, cover you with skin and put breath in you, and you will come to life. Then you will know that I am the LORD.'"
So I prophesied as I had been commanded. As I was prophesying, there was a noise, a rattling, and the bones came together, bone to its bone.
I looked, and there were sinews on them, and flesh had grown, and skin had covered them over; but there was no breath in them.

Then he said to me, "Prophesy to the breath; prophesy, son of man, and say to the breath, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Come from the four winds, breath, and breathe into these slain, so that they may live.'"
So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them. They came to life and stood on their feet, a very great army.
Then he said to me, "Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Look, they are saying, 'Our bones are dried up, and our hope is gone. We are cut off completely.'
Therefore prophesy and say to them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: I am going to open your graves and bring you up from your graves, my people, and I will bring you into the land of Israel.
Then you will know that I am the LORD, when I open your graves and bring you up from your graves, my people.
I will put my Spirit in you, and you will come to life, and I will settle you in your own land. Then you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will do it, declares the LORD.'"
The word of the LORD came to me:

"As for you, son of man, take a stick and write on it, 'For Judah, and for the Israelites, his companions.' Then take another stick and write on it, 'For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and all the house of Israel, his companions.'
Join them together into one stick, so that they become one in your hand.
When your people say to you, 'Won't you tell us what you mean by these?'

say to them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: I am going to take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel, his companions, and I will put them together with the stick of Judah. I will make them into one stick, and they will be one in my hand.'
The sticks you write on are to be in your hand before their eyes.

Then say to them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: I am going to take the Israelites from among the nations where they have gone. I will gather them from all around and bring them into their own land.

I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel, and one king will be king over all of them. They will no longer be two nations, and they will never again be divided into two kingdoms.

They will no longer defile themselves with their idols and their vile idols and all their transgressions. I will save them from all their dwelling places where they sinned, and I will cleanse them. They will be my people, and I will be their God.
My servant David will be king over them, and they will all have one shepherd. They will walk in my rulings and keep my decrees and carry them out.

They will live in the land I gave to my servant Jacob, where your ancestors lived. They will live in it, they and their children and their children's children, forever, and David my servant will be their prince forever.
I will make a covenant of peace with them; it will be an everlasting covenant with them. I will establish them and multiply them, and I will set my sanctuary among them forever.
My dwelling place will be with them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
Then the nations will know that I am the LORD, who makes Israel holy, when my sanctuary is among them forever.'"
The word of the LORD came to me:
Son of man, set your face toward Gog, of the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal, and prophesy against him.
Say: This is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am against you, Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.

I will turn you around, put hooks in your jaws, and bring you out with all your army, horses and horsemen, all of them in full armor, a great company with large shield and small shield, all of them wielding swords.
Persia, Cush and Put are with them, all of them with shield and helmet,
Gomer and all its troops, Beth-togarmah from the far reaches of the north with all its troops: many peoples are with you.
Be ready, and prepare yourself, you and all your company that has gathered around you, and take charge of them.

After many days you will be summoned. In the latter years you will come against a land that has been restored from the sword, whose people have been gathered from many peoples onto the mountains of Israel, which had long lain in ruins. Its people were brought out from the peoples, and now all of them live securely.
You will go up and come like a storm; you will be like a cloud covering the land, you and all your troops and many peoples with you.
This is what the Lord GOD says: On that day thoughts will come into your mind, and you will devise an evil plan.
You will say, "I will go up against a land of open villages. I will come against a quiet people who live securely, all of them living without walls, with no bars or gates,"

to seize spoil and carry off plunder, to turn your hand against the ruins that are now inhabited, and against the people gathered from the nations, who are acquiring livestock and goods, who live at the center of the earth.

Sheba and Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish and all its young lions, will say to you, "Have you come to seize spoil? Have you gathered your company to carry off plunder, to carry away silver and gold, to take livestock and goods, to seize great spoil?"
Therefore prophesy, son of man, and say to Gog: This is what the Lord GOD says: On that day, when my people Israel are living securely, will you not take notice?
You will come from your place in the far reaches of the north, you and many peoples with you, all of them riding horses, a great company, a mighty army.

You will come up against my people Israel like a cloud covering the land. In the latter days I will bring you against my land, so that the nations may know me, when I show myself holy through you, Gog, before their eyes.
This is what the Lord GOD says: Are you the one I spoke of in former days through my servants the prophets of Israel, who prophesied in those days, for years, that I would bring you against them?
On that day, the day when Gog comes against the land of Israel, declares the Lord GOD, my wrath will flare up in my anger.
In my jealousy, in the fire of my fury, I declare that on that day there will be a great earthquake in the land of Israel.

The fish of the sea, the birds of the sky, the animals of the field, every creature that creeps on the ground, and all the people on the face of the earth will quake at my presence. The mountains will be thrown down, the cliffs will collapse, and every wall will fall to the ground.
I will call for a sword against him on all my mountains, declares the Lord GOD. Every man's sword will be against his brother.
I will enter into judgment with him by plague and bloodshed. I will rain down on him and his troops, and on the many peoples with him, torrents of rain, hailstones, fire and sulfur.
So I will show my greatness and my holiness, and make myself known in the sight of many nations. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
As for you, son of man, prophesy against Gog and say: This is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am against you, Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.
I will turn you around and drive you on, and bring you up from the far reaches of the north, and bring you against the mountains of Israel.
I will strike your bow from your left hand and make your arrows drop from your right hand.
On the mountains of Israel you will fall, you and all your troops and the peoples who are with you. I will give you as food to birds of prey of every kind and to the wild animals.
You will fall on the open field, for I have spoken, declares the Lord GOD.
I will send fire on Magog and on those who live securely in the coastlands. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
I will make my holy name known among my people Israel, and I will no longer let my holy name be profaned. Then the nations will know that I am the LORD, the Holy One in Israel.
Look, it is coming, and it will be done, declares the Lord GOD. This is the day I have spoken of.

Then those who live in the cities of Israel will go out and use the weapons for fuel and burn them: small shields and large shields, bows and arrows, war clubs and spears. They will make fires with them for seven years.
